blocks.en: 7 System and workflow details
blocks.zh: 7 系统和工作流程细节

blocks.en:
This appendix adds component-level detail to the system summarised in Section 3 .
Here we specify the components and backends used at each stage of that pipeline.
blocks.zh:
本附录为第3节概述的系统增加了构成部分层面的细节。
在此,我们具体说明管道每个阶段使用的组件和后端。

blocks.en: 7.1 Pipeline components and backends
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 管道组件和后端

blocks.en: Each stage of the pipeline is handled by distinct, interchangeable components, which a researcher can swap to suit their setup.
blocks.zh: 管道的每个阶段都由不同的可互换的部件处理,研究者可以互换来适应它们的设置.

blocks.en: 7.1.1 Phase 1: Ingestion and Indexing
blocks.zh: 7.1.1 国家 第1阶段:摄入和索引编制

blocks.en:
This phase transforms a collection of scientific papers into a searchable index.
It involves parsing, chunking, embedding, and storing the content.
blocks.zh:
这一阶段将一批科学论文转化为可搜索索引.
它涉及分析、分解、嵌入和储存内容。

blocks.en:
The workflow begins by parsing PDF documents into structured text. EpiLens uses GROBID gro (2008–2025) for this task, which is optimized for academic papers and can extract not only plain text but also rich metadata (title, authors, journal), structured sections (abstract, methods, results), and a bibliography.
For non-PDF files or as a fallback, the Unstructured Uns (2026) library is used.
The parsed metadata and structured content are stored in MongoDB or in memory.
blocks.zh:
工作流程首先将PDF文档分解为结构化文本. EpiLens为此任务使用GROBID groll (2008–2025),该GROBID对学术论文进行了优化,不仅可以取出纯文本,还可以取出丰富的元数据(标题,作者,日记),结构化部分(摘要,方法,结果)和书目.
对于非PDF文件或作为倒置,使用无结构 Uns (2026) 库.
解析后元数据和结构化内容被存储于MongoDB或内存.

blocks.en:
To create focused, contextually relevant units for retrieval, the parsed text sections are segmented into smaller chunks.
EpiLens provides many of the standard strategies, including splitting by paragraph, sentence, or fixed-size overlapping windows.
When not specified otherwise, in our experiments we split by paragraph.
blocks.zh:
为了创建有重点、与背景相关的检索单元,解析后的案文部分被分割成更小的块。
EpiLens提供了许多标准策略,包括分出段落,句子,或固定大小相重叠的窗口.
在没有具体指明的情况下,我们在实验中将各段分开。

blocks.en:
Each text chunk is mapped to a high-dimensional vector using an embedding model.
EpiLens is model-agnostic and supports a range of providers, including open-source sentence-transformer models from Hugging Face, as well as API-based models from OpenAI, Google (Gemini), and local models served via Ollama.
This allows for flexibility in balancing performance, computational cost, and privacy.
blocks.zh:
每个文本块都使用嵌入模型被映射到高维向量.
EpiLens是模型-不可知论的,支持一系列的提供商,包括Hugging Face的开源句转换模型,以及OpenAI,Google(Gemini)的API基模型,以及通过Ollama服务的地方模型.
这使得能够灵活地平衡性能、计算成本和隐私。

blocks.en:
The generated embeddings and their associated metadata (e.g., paper ID, section title, original text) are stored in a vector database.
This database provides the core functionality for efficient similarity search. EpiLens includes swappable backends for Qdrant , FAISS , and a simple file-based storage system, enabling deployment in various environments from local machines to server-based setups.
blocks.zh:
所生成的嵌入及其相关的元数据(如纸质ID,片段标题,原始文本)被存储在一个矢量数据库中.
这个数据库为高效的相似性搜索提供了核心功能. EpiLens包括了可互换的Qdrant后端,FAISS,以及一个简单的基于文件的存储系统,允许从本地机器到基于服务器的设置在各种环境中部署.

blocks.en: 7.1.2 Phase 2: Retrieval
blocks.zh: 7.1.2 国家 阶段2:检索

blocks.en: The retrieval phase calls the vector database to find the most relevant indexed text chunks in response to a user query.
blocks.zh: 检索阶段将调用矢量数据库,以找到最相关的索引文本块来响应用户的查询.

blocks.en:
EpiLens supports multiple retrieval modes.
The primary mode is semantic search , where a user query is embedded using the same model as the document chunks, and the vector database is searched for the "nearest" chunk embeddings.
For the experiments in the main text we used Qdrant .
A keyword search is also available for simple term matching.
blocks.zh:
EpiLens支持多个检索模式.
主要模式是语义搜索 . 其中使用与文档块相同的模式嵌入用户查询,矢量数据库被搜索到"最相近"的块嵌入.
我们用克德兰特来做实验
一个关键词搜索也可用于简单的术语匹配.

blocks.en:
The core retrieval operation is a nearest-neighbor search performed by the vector database.
Results can be filtered by metadata, for instance by restricting the search to a specific paper ID or a set of paper sections (e.g., methods ).
For the experiments presented in the main text we used cosine similarity as distance metric.
The standard RAG approach uses the user query as reference for finding similar chunks.
We additionally use a template-based approach (see Section 7.2 ).
blocks.zh:
核心取回操作是由矢量数据库进行的近邻搜索.
可以通过元数据过滤结果,例如,将搜索限制在特定的纸张ID或一组纸张部分(例如方法.)。
对于正文中介绍的实验,我们使用同位素相似度作为距离度量.
标准RAG方法使用用户查询作为查找类似块的参考.
我们还采用基于模板的办法(见第7.2节)。

blocks.en: 7.1.3 Phase 3: Generation
blocks.zh: 7.1.3 国家 第3阶段:生成

blocks.en: In the final phase, an LLM synthesizes a coherent answer from the retrieved evidence.
blocks.zh: 在最后阶段,LLM综合了从所取出的证据中得出的一致答案.

blocks.en:
The retrieved text chunks are compiled into a carefully structured prompt, along with the original user query.
The prompt explicitly instructs the LLM to formulate its answer strictly based on the provided evidence and to refrain from using its internal knowledge.
For the workflows discussed in Section 7.2 , we provide a schema to guide the model toward generating a JSON output with specific characteristics.
blocks.zh:
检索到的文本块与原始用户查询一起编成一个结构仔细的提示。
迅速行动明确指示LLM严格根据所提供的证据制定答案,并避免利用其内部知识。
对于第7.2节所讨论的工作流程,我们提供了一个计划,以指导模型产生具有具体特点的JSON产出。

blocks.en: EpiLens’s Generator component sends the prompt to a local or remote LLM through a provider client. This allows users to select a model that fits their requirements for performance, privacy, and cost.
blocks.zh: EpiLens 的生成器组件通过提供者客户端向本地或远程 LLM 发送提示 。 这使得用户可以选择一个符合其性能,隐私和成本要求的模型.

blocks.en:
A core principle of EpiLens is to ensure transparency.
Every generated answer is accompanied by a list of evidence items, each tracing back to a specific text chunk from a source paper and containing the original snippet, the paper ID, and the section.
This makes it possible to inspect the path from query to answer and check the output against the cited source passages.
blocks.zh:
EpiLens的一项核心原则是确保透明度。
每个生成的答案都附有一份证据项清单,每次追踪都从原始文件返回到一个特定的文本块并包含原始片段,纸上的身份和部分.
这样就可以检查从查询到回答的路径,对照所引用的源段落检查输出.

blocks.en: 7.2 High-Level Analytical Workflows in EpiLens
blocks.zh: 7.2 EpiLens的高级分析工作流量

blocks.en:
The structured-workflow contract (a fixed retrieval template plus a validating JSON schema , implemented with Pydantic ( Colvin et al., 2024 ) and applied identically across a corpus) is defined in Section 3 .
Here we record the implementation specifics of the two instantiations used in this paper, the Precision Miner (extraction) and the Paper Classifier (classification). They reuse the same ingestion, retriever, generator, validation, and provenance components, but use workflow-specific evidence aggregation, prompts, schemas, and parsing.
blocks.zh:
第3节界定了结构化-工作流程合同(固定检索模板外加验证的JSON schema -- -- 与Pydantic(Colvin等,2024年)共同执行,并适用于一个实体)。
在此,我们记录了本文件中所用的两个即时说明,即 " 精密矿工 " 和 " 纸张分类器 " (分类)。 它们重新使用相同的摄取、取回器、生成器、验证和出处组件,但使用特定工作流程的证据汇总、提示、计划以及解析。

blocks.en: 7.2.1 The Precision Miner for Structured Extraction
blocks.zh: 7.2.1 结构化开采的精密矿工

blocks.en:
The Precision Miner is the extraction instantiation of the pattern.
It finds and lists specific, concrete pieces of information in a paper, such as the data sources used, links to supplementary materials, or key bibliographic references.
blocks.zh:
精密矿工(Precise Miner)是图案的取出即时化.
它在文件中找到并列出具体的资料,例如所使用的数据来源、与补充材料的链接或主要参考书目。

blocks.en: The miner’s implementation of the pattern is geared towards maximising the discovery of relevant facts within a document. • Retrieval phase (multi-query aggregation): The miner is configured with several queries designed to find relevant passages (for example, “What datasets were used in this study?” or “Where can supplementary data be found?”). It searches each paper separately for every query, can restrict candidates by section, and combines the results into one deduplicated, score-ranked evidence pool. The multi-query strategy is intended to broaden candidate coverage without guaranteeing recall. • Generation phase (the LLM as an extractor): The consolidated evidence pool is formatted into a prompt and sent to the LLM, which is given the role of an information extractor: it scans the snippets, identifies every instance of the target information (for example, dataset names and URLs), and organises them into a list. The JSON schema requires an object containing this list, where each item has fields such as name , url , and explanation , with the source sentence retained as provenance.
blocks.zh: 矿工执行这一模式是为了最大限度地发现文件中的有关事实。 · 检索阶段(多管聚合): 该矿工配置了几个查询,旨在查找相关段落(例如,“本研究使用了哪些数据集?” 或“何处可找到补充数据?” 它为每个查询分别搜索出每张论文,可以逐节限制考生,并将结果合并为一个被贬低的分数证据集合. 多管战略旨在扩大候选人的覆盖范围,而不保证召回。 • 生成阶段(LLM作为提取器): 综合证据集合被格式化为一个即时的并被发送到LLM,它被赋予信息提取器的作用:它扫描片段,识别目标信息的每一个实例(例如数据集名称和URL),并将其组织成一个列表. JSON schema 需要包含此列表的对象, 其中每个项目都有诸如名称, url, 和解释等字段, 源句保留为出处 。

blocks.en: Retrieval phase (multi-query aggregation): The miner is configured with several queries designed to find relevant passages (for example, “What datasets were used in this study?” or “Where can supplementary data be found?”). It searches each paper separately for every query, can restrict candidates by section, and combines the results into one deduplicated, score-ranked evidence pool. The multi-query strategy is intended to broaden candidate coverage without guaranteeing recall.
blocks.zh: 检索阶段(多等同): 该矿工配置了几个查询,旨在查找相关段落(例如,“本研究使用了哪些数据集?” 或“何处可找到补充数据?” 它为每个查询分别搜索出每张论文,可以逐节限制考生,并将结果合并为一个被贬低的分数证据集合. 多管战略旨在扩大候选人的覆盖范围,而不保证召回。

blocks.en: Generation phase (the LLM as an extractor): The consolidated evidence pool is formatted into a prompt and sent to the LLM, which is given the role of an information extractor: it scans the snippets, identifies every instance of the target information (for example, dataset names and URLs), and organises them into a list. The JSON schema requires an object containing this list, where each item has fields such as name , url , and explanation , with the source sentence retained as provenance.
blocks.zh: 生成相( LLM 作为提取相): 综合证据集合被格式化为一个即时的并被发送到LLM,它被赋予信息提取器的作用:它扫描片段,识别目标信息的每一个实例(例如数据集名称和URL),并将其组织成一个列表. JSON schema 需要包含此列表的对象, 其中每个项目都有诸如名称, url, 和解释等字段, 源句保留为出处 。

blocks.en:
We ran the find_data_sources variant of the miner over the corpus index on four corpus papers, one per pathogen family, to show what an extraction workflow returns rather than to benchmark its accuracy. Table 1 lists the result: for each paper, a variable-length list of concrete data sources, each with a link or accession where the paper supplies one.
The recovered sources are heterogeneous, from public code and data repositories (GitHub, Zenodo, GenBank) to surveillance systems, reference datasets (WHO, NOAA, a national soil survey), and the cited studies behind model parameters.
Other variants ship with the package to find supplementary materials or key references.
The table is limited to paper identifiers, source names, and links or accessions: the miner also returns source sentences and model explanations for auditing a run, but these can reproduce publisher text and are not redistributed.

blocks.en: 7.2.2 The Paper Classifier for Automated Categorization
blocks.zh: 7.2.2 自动化分类的纸张分类器

blocks.en:
The Paper Classifier instantiates this pattern for classification.
It is designed to automatically assign categorical labels to an entire paper along predefined axes, such as study design, data accessibility, or geographic focus.
blocks.zh:
纸张分类器将这个模式作为分类的即时.
它旨在按照预先定义的轴自动为一整张纸指定绝对的标签,如研究设计,数据可访问性,或地理焦点等.

blocks.en:
The classifier’s implementation is tailored to gather comparative evidence and facilitate a judgment. • Retrieval Phase (Evidence Gathering by Category): Unlike the miner, the classifier’s templates are exemplars : canonical text snippets that represent each of the possible categories in a classification scheme (e.g., a sentence describing open data access is an exemplar for the ’Open Data’ category).
Each exemplar retrieves its nearest chunks from the paper, and each distinct chunk is assigned to the category whose exemplar it matches best.
The k k highest-scoring chunks across all categories are passed to the model grouped by category, as a structured “dossier” of evidence for the competing labels. A label whose exemplars match only weakly may receive no chunk. • Generation Phase (The LLM as a Classifier): This comparative dossier is presented to the LLM.
Its task is not to extract items, but to weigh the evidence for the competing categories and make a final, reasoned decision about which label (or labels) best applies to the paper as a whole.
The JSON schema requires one or more valid labels and a textual justification. A confidence score is optional. Schema validation makes the output structured, while the retained passages make the decision inspectable.
blocks.zh:
分类员的执行是为了收集比较证据和便利判断。 • 检索阶段(按类别收集证据): 与矿工不同的是,分类器的模板是实例: 代表分类计划中每个可能分类的犬形文字片段(例如,描述开放数据访问的句子是"开放数据"类别的示例).
每个实例从纸张中取出其最近的块,每个不同的块被划入其实例最匹配的类别。
所有类别的克分数最高的块被转至按类别分类的模型,作为相互竞争的标签的一种结构化的“比较多的证据”。 其实例匹配度微弱的标签可能不会收到块. • 生成阶段(LLM作为分类器): 这一比较档案材料已提交LLM。
它的任务不是取出物品,而是权衡相互竞争的类别的证据,并就哪种标签(或标签)最适合整个纸张作出最后的、合理的决定。
JSON schema 需要一个或多个有效的标签和文字解释. 信心分数是可选的. Schema验证使输出结构化,而所保留的段落使得决定可以检查.

blocks.en: 7.3 Token usage and projected inference cost
blocks.zh: 7.3 托肯使用和预测推断费用

blocks.en:
This section estimates the token cost of running the EpiLens Paper Classifier over a corpus.
A classification pass has two components: (i) a one-time embedding stage that indexes the corpus for retrieval, and (ii) a per-call generation stage that classifies each paper on each axis.
We report token usage rather than monetary cost, allowing readers to convert these figures using the pricing model of their chosen provider.
Embedding costs were estimated from corpus statistics, as described below.

EpiLens performs one classification case per paper for each of the four axes, with an additional invocation when repair is needed.
Averaged across all axes, classifying a single paper requires approximately 20,000 20{,}000 tokens (roughly 14,000 14{,}000 input and 5,500 5{,}500 output tokens).
Scaling the proxy per-case averages to the full corpus of 2,297 papers ( 9188 9188 classification cases) gives approximately 33 33 M input and 13 13 M output tokens, or about 46 46 M generation tokens in total ( Table 3 ). The 214 214 -paper evaluation corpus corresponds to approximately 4.3 4.3 M generation tokens.
Alternative backends, particularly non-reasoning models, would substantially reduce output-token usage but may exhibit different classification accuracy.

blocks.en:
Generation is only one component of the overall token budget. Retrieval additionally requires embedding the corpus, although this cost is incurred only once when constructing the index.
Unlike generation, embedding usage was not metered directly.
Instead, we estimate it from corpus statistics.
Using the observed mean of 33 33 retained chunks of about 190 190 tokens each gives approximately 6300 6300 embedded tokens per paper, or roughly 14 14 M tokens for the complete corpus. This is an approximation because chunking can overlap text and can omit short fragments. The cost is amortised across subsequent workflows that reuse the same index.
The queries, a fixed set of short exemplar paragraphs (one for each candidate label), are embedded once and reused for every paper, so their cost is negligible.
Overall, corpus indexing contributes an estimated one-time cost of about 14 14 M embedding tokens, compared with approximately 46 46 M generation tokens for each complete classification pass ( Table 3 ).

准确重建文件收藏仍取决于访问。 图1显示管道情况。

blocks.en: 8.1 Stage 1: LLM-Assisted Review Expansion
blocks.zh: 8.1 第一阶段:LLM-Associated审查扩展

blocks.en:
The first stage identifies the papers reported as included evidence by each seed source selected for review expansion.
Parsing the complete reference section is insufficient because a review can cite many papers that were not included in its analysis.
We therefore target the subset of references that are explicitly described as included studies in the review text, tables, or appendices.
blocks.zh:
第一阶段确定所报文件,包括选定供审查扩充的每个种子来源提供的证据。
分析整个参考部分是不够的,因为审查可以引用许多没有列入分析的文件。
因此,我们针对的是在审查案文、表格或附录中被明确描述为包括研究的参考资料。

blocks.en:
Stage 1 uses LLM-assisted reference extraction followed by rule-based matching to identify included evidence for each source review.
The extraction and matching code is maintained separately from EpiLens.
For each source review selected for expansion, we execute the following steps. 1. Candidate extraction. An LLM reads the review PDF and extracts spans that enumerate included studies.
This includes narrative “study characteristics” descriptions and tables listing included trials or observational studies.
We use Gemini’s document understanding ( gem, 2026a ; gem, 2026b ) , prompting the model to output the included studies as full bibliographic citations exactly as reported in the review’s reference list.
When the included studies are listed in a supplementary file rather than the main text, the model returns the supplement’s label (e.g., “Supplementary Table S1”) and URL instead, and the supplement is processed case by case. 2. Bibliographic parsing and normalization. In parallel, the review PDF is processed with GROBID to extract structured bibliographic records and reference strings ( gro, 2008–2025 ) . 3. Candidate–bibliography matching. We index bibliography entries by the normalised surname of the first author and link each LLM-extracted candidate to one entry.
A unique exact surname match is selected directly.
When several entries share that surname, the implementation compares the normalised candidate with each entry’s title plus raw reference string using RapidFuzz’s fuzz.ratio similarity ( rap, 2020 ) .
A score of at least 65 65 is recorded as title-based disambiguation. Below that threshold, the highest-scoring same-surname entry is retained and explicitly marked as an ambiguous best guess.
If there is no exact surname token, surnames are compared fuzzily and accepted at a threshold of 70 70 .
Candidates with no accepted surname match are marked unmatched and excluded from downstream stages.
This constrains candidates to bibliography entries parsed independently from the source PDF and records the match score and reason for audit. 4. Storage. We store the extracted candidate text, the matched bibliographic record, and the matching confidence in a relational SQLite database.
The database also records run metadata and versioned pipeline settings to support reproducibility and error analysis.
blocks.zh:
第1阶段采用LLM辅助的参考提取,然后按规则进行比对,为每次源审查确定包含的证据.
提取和匹配代码与EpiLens分开维持.
对于每次选择扩展的源评论,我们执行以下步骤. 1. 候选人提取。 一个LLM读取了PDF的审查并摘录了包括研究在内的内容。
这包括叙述性“学习特征”说明和包括试验或观察研究在内的表格。
我们使用双子座的文件理解(gem, 2026a;gem, 2026b),
当包含的研究被列在一个补充文件中而不是正文中时,模型会返回补充的标签(例如 " 补充表S1 " )和URL,而补充的则逐个处理。 2. 书目分析和正常化。 同时,与GROBID一起处理PDF审查,以提取结构化的书目记录和参考字符串(gro,2008–2025). 3. 候选文献匹配。 我们按第一作者的常姓索引书目条目,并将每个LLM提取的候选人链接到一个条目。
直接选择一个独特的准确姓氏匹配 。
当多个条目共享该姓氏时,执行将常态候选人与每个条目的标题相提并论,加上使用RapidFuzz's fuzz.ratio相似性(rap, 2020)的原始参考字符串.
至少65-65分的分数被记录为以头衔为基础的分数相混淆. 在该阈值下方,保留得分最高的同名条目,并明确标出为模棱两可的最佳猜测.
如果没有准确的姓氏标志,则对姓氏进行模糊的比较,接受的门槛为70-70。
没有被接受的姓氏相配的候选人被标记为无与伦比并被排除在下游阶段之外.
这限制了考生从来源PDF中独立解析出书目,并记录对应分数和审计理由. 4. 储存。 我们保存了提取的候选文本,匹配的书目记录,以及匹配的SQLite数据库中的信任度.
数据库还记录了元数据和版本化的管道设置,以支持可再生性和错误分析.

blocks.en:
Candidate extraction. An LLM reads the review PDF and extracts spans that enumerate included studies.
This includes narrative “study characteristics” descriptions and tables listing included trials or observational studies.
We use Gemini’s document understanding ( gem, 2026a ; gem, 2026b ) , prompting the model to output the included studies as full bibliographic citations exactly as reported in the review’s reference list.
When the included studies are listed in a supplementary file rather than the main text, the model returns the supplement’s label (e.g., “Supplementary Table S1”) and URL instead, and the supplement is processed case by case.
blocks.zh:
候选人提取。 一个LLM读取了PDF的审查并摘录了包括研究在内的内容。
这包括叙述性“学习特征”说明和包括试验或观察研究在内的表格。
我们使用双子座的文件理解(gem, 2026a;gem, 2026b),
当包含的研究被列在一个补充文件中而不是正文中时,模型会返回补充的标签(例如 " 补充表S1 " )和URL,而补充的则逐个处理。

blocks.en: Bibliographic parsing and normalization. In parallel, the review PDF is processed with GROBID to extract structured bibliographic records and reference strings ( gro, 2008–2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 书目分析和正常化。 同时,与GROBID一起处理PDF审查,以提取结构化的书目记录和参考字符串(gro,2008–2025).

blocks.en:
Candidate–bibliography matching. We index bibliography entries by the normalised surname of the first author and link each LLM-extracted candidate to one entry.
A unique exact surname match is selected directly.
When several entries share that surname, the implementation compares the normalised candidate with each entry’s title plus raw reference string using RapidFuzz’s fuzz.ratio similarity ( rap, 2020 ) .
A score of at least 65 65 is recorded as title-based disambiguation. Below that threshold, the highest-scoring same-surname entry is retained and explicitly marked as an ambiguous best guess.
If there is no exact surname token, surnames are compared fuzzily and accepted at a threshold of 70 70 .
Candidates with no accepted surname match are marked unmatched and excluded from downstream stages.
This constrains candidates to bibliography entries parsed independently from the source PDF and records the match score and reason for audit.
blocks.zh:
候选文献匹配 。 我们按第一作者的常姓索引书目条目,并将每个LLM提取的候选人链接到一个条目。
直接选择一个独特的准确姓氏匹配 。
当多个条目共享该姓氏时,执行将常态候选人与每个条目的标题相提并论,加上使用RapidFuzz's fuzz.ratio相似性(rap, 2020)的原始参考字符串.
至少65-65分的分数被记录为以头衔为基础的分数相混淆. 在该阈值下方,保留得分最高的同名条目,并明确标出为模棱两可的最佳猜测.
如果没有准确的姓氏标志,则对姓氏进行模糊的比较,接受的门槛为70-70。
没有被接受的姓氏相配的候选人被标记为无与伦比并被排除在下游阶段之外.
这限制了考生从来源PDF中独立解析出书目,并记录对应分数和审计理由.

blocks.en:
Storage. We store the extracted candidate text, the matched bibliographic record, and the matching confidence in a relational SQLite database.
The database also records run metadata and versioned pipeline settings to support reproducibility and error analysis.
blocks.zh:
存储。 我们保存了提取的候选文本,匹配的书目记录,以及匹配的SQLite数据库中的信任度.
数据库还记录了元数据和版本化的管道设置,以支持可再生性和错误分析.

blocks.en: 8.2 Stage 2: Metadata Backfilling and DOI Resolution
blocks.zh: 8.2 第2阶段:元数据回填和DOI分辨率

blocks.en:
Matched references can lack a DOI or carry incomplete metadata.
Stage 2 retains a DOI parsed by GROBID when present and otherwise attempts to resolve one through Crossref ( Hendricks et al., 2020 ) .
Directly cited source documents enter the pipeline at this stage.
blocks.zh:
相匹配的引用可能缺少一个DOI或者携带不完整的元数据.
第2阶段保留了由GROBID解析的DOI, 当存在或试图通过Crossref解决(Hendricks等人,2020年)。
在此阶段直接引用的源文件进入管道.

blocks.en: For each matched reference without a DOI, the implementation: 1. Bibliographic query. Queries Crossref with the title, up to two author strings, journal, and, where available, a publication-year filter. 2. Candidate scoring. Ranks the returned records by title similarity using RapidFuzz token_set_ratio , dividing its score by 100 100 to place it on a 0 0 – 1 1 scale. 3. Database update. Writes the DOI of the best candidate when title similarity is at least 0.85 0.85 . Otherwise it retains the unresolved status or query error.
blocks.zh: 对于每个没有DOI的匹配引用,执行: 1. 书目查询。 带有标题的查询 Crossref,最多可有两个作者字符串,日记,如果有,还可以有出版年过滤. 2. 候选人得分。 使用 RapidFuzz sord_set_ratio 按标题的相似性对返回的记录进行排名,将其分数除以100-100,将其排入0-1分级. 3. 数据库更新。 当头衔相似性至少为0.85 0.85 时,将最佳候选人写成DOI. 否则它会保留未解决的状态或查询错误.

blocks.en: Bibliographic query. Queries Crossref with the title, up to two author strings, journal, and, where available, a publication-year filter.
blocks.zh: 书目查询. 带有标题的查询 Crossref,最多可有两个作者字符串,日记,如果有,还可以有出版年过滤.

blocks.en: Candidate scoring. Ranks the returned records by title similarity using RapidFuzz token_set_ratio , dividing its score by 100 100 to place it on a 0 0 – 1 1 scale.
blocks.zh: 候选人得分. 使用 RapidFuzz sord_set_ratio 按标题的相似性对返回的记录进行排名,将其分数除以100-100,将其排入0-1分级.

blocks.en: Database update. Writes the DOI of the best candidate when title similarity is at least 0.85 0.85 . Otherwise it retains the unresolved status or query error.
blocks.zh: 数据库更新. 当头衔相似程度至少为0.850.85. 否则它会保留未解决的状态或查询错误.

blocks.en: 8.3 Stage 3: Semi-Automated Document Retrieval
blocks.zh: 8.3 第3阶段:半自动文件检索

blocks.en: Stage 3 attempted to obtain the documents identified in Stage 2. The collection that can be recovered depends on access to those documents at the time of retrieval.
blocks.zh: 第3阶段试图获得第2阶段确定的文件。 可以收回的藏品取决于在检索时能否取用这些文件。

blocks.en:
We ran a DOI-driven PDF harvester over the resolved identifiers.
It searched online for full-text copies of each paper, downloaded candidate PDFs, and logged successes and failures.
For unresolved cases, a fallback script searched DOI and PubMed landing pages for PDF links.
We then examined failures and suspect files manually, recovered papers where possible, and checked that the retained files were valid PDFs.
The archived download records also identify documents already obtained through another review.
The released corpus manifest lists the papers retained for analysis ( Perri et al., 2026 ) , with identifiers that readers can use to attempt retrieval under their own access conditions.
Files of directly cited sources were named by year, first author, and parameter.
blocks.zh:
我们用DOI驱动的PDF收割机 检查了已解决的识别器
它在网上搜索每份文件的全文,下载候选PDF,记录成败。
对于未解决的案件,一个倒计时脚本搜索了DOI和PubMed登陆页的PDF链接.
然后,我们手动检查失败和疑似档案,尽可能收回文件,并检查保留的文件是否是有效的PDF.
存档的下载记录还指明了通过另一次审查已经获得的文件。
公布的案卷清单列出了供分析的论文(Perri等人,2026年),其中附有识别资料,读者可以在自己的准入条件下尝试检索。
直接引用来源的文件按年份、第一作者和参数命名。

blocks.en: 8.4 Stage 4: Corpus Ingestion and Structuring
blocks.zh: 8.4 第4阶段:公司摄入和结构

blocks.en: Stage 4 converts the retrieved documents into the structured representation used by EpiLens for downstream indexing and RAG workflows.
blocks.zh: 第四阶段将取回的文件转换为EpiLens用于下游索引和RAG工作流程的结构化表述.

blocks.en:
We process each document as follows. 1. Deep parsing. Each PDF is parsed with GROBID into structured TEI XML, including section boundaries, metadata, and a parsed bibliography ( gro, 2008–2025 ) . 2. Corpus database population. We insert the parsed representation into the corpus database (MongoDB) as the source of truth for retrieval and provenance. The frozen manifest contains 2,297 corpus records used by every downstream analysis.
The resulting records are then available for embedding, vector indexing, and query-dependent retrieval.
blocks.zh:
我们按以下方式处理每份文件。 1. 深入分析。 每个PDF都用GROBID解析成结构化的TEI XML,包括区段边界,元数据,以及被解析的书目(gro,2008–2025). 2. 公司数据库人口。 我们把经解析的表述内容输入到委托书数据库(MongoDB),作为检索和出处的真相来源。 冻结清单中载有下游分析所用的2 297份案卷记录。
由此产生的记录随后可用于嵌入、矢量索引和依赖查询的检索。

blocks.en: Deep parsing. Each PDF is parsed with GROBID into structured TEI XML, including section boundaries, metadata, and a parsed bibliography ( gro, 2008–2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 深入解说. 每个PDF都用GROBID解析成结构化的TEI XML,包括分区边界,元数据,以及解析的书目(gro,2008–2025) 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Corpus database population. We insert the parsed representation into the corpus database (MongoDB) as the source of truth for retrieval and provenance.
blocks.zh: Corpus数据库人口. 我们把经解析的表述内容输入到委托书数据库(MongoDB),作为检索和出处的真相来源。

blocks.en: 9 Labeling protocol
blocks.zh: 9 标签协议

blocks.en:
This appendix defines four classification axes: the geography, accessibility, and type of the data used, and the paper’s main research contribution. The first three describe the datasets a paper uses. The fourth describes the paper as a whole.
Making these principles explicit is essential both for defining the labels used as ground truth and for ensuring consistency between these criteria and the instructions provided in the LLM prompts, which would otherwise default to unknown and potentially inconsistent standards.
Specifically, some documents may plausibly fall into more than one category, depending on interpretation, or may be sensitive to where boundaries are drawn between categories in the context of our specific classification task.
Potentially ambiguous cases include unclear data availability statements (e.g., claims that data are in the public domain, which may apply only under specific emergency conditions), the appropriate geographic labelling of analyses of contagion events originating in one country but detected in another, and the classification of paper types consistently with the practices of the relevant scientific community (in this case, epidemiology).
blocks.zh:
本附录定义了四个分类轴:所使用的数据的地理,可获取性和类型,以及论文的主要研究贡献. 前三段描述一纸使用的数据集. 第四一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一一.
明确这些原则对于界定用作基本真理的标签和确保这些标准与LLM提示中提供的指示之间的一致性至关重要,否则,LLM提示将违反未知和可能不一致的标准。
具体而言,根据解释,有些文件可能合理属于一个以上类别,或者对我们具体分类任务中划分类别之间的界限可能敏感。
可能模棱两可的案例包括数据提供说明不明确(例如,声称数据属于公共领域,可能只在具体紧急情况下适用);对起源于一个国家但在另一个国家被检测到的传染事件的分析进行适当的地理标记;以及按照有关科学界的做法对纸张类型进行分类(此处指流行病学)。

blocks.en:
For the three data axes (geography, data accessibility, and data type), classification applies to the individual datasets within a paper, not to the paper itself.
Each dataset used to obtain results via the described methodology is assigned a label.
This excludes datasets that, e.g., are only mentioned in a background section.
The final output for each axis is the union of these per-dataset labels, so duplicates are automatically collapsed: if three datasets are assigned labels A A , A A , and B B , the resulting set is { A , B } \{A,B\} .
The fourth axis, paper type, is instead assigned at the level of the whole paper, as described in its own section below.
blocks.zh:
对于三个数据轴(地理学,数据可获取性,和数据类型),分类适用于一纸中的单个数据集,而不适用于一纸本身.
通过所述方法获得结果的每个数据集都配有标签。
这不包括仅在背景一节中提及的数据集。
每个轴的最终输出是这些每个数据集标签的结合,所以复制会自动倒塌:如果三个数据集被指定了A,A,和B等标签,那么结果的集是{A,B}QQA,B\}.
第四个轴线,即纸张类型,则按本文本身一节所述,划入整份文件的级别。

blocks.en: 9.1 Label set
blocks.zh: 9.1 标签集

blocks.en: We assign labels along four axes, the first three abbreviated GEO, DAVAIL, and DTYPE below:
blocks.zh: 我们沿着四个轴线分配标签,前面三个缩写为GEO,DAVAIL,下面是DTYPE:

blocks.en: 1. Geography. A set-valued label capturing the continents associated with the epidemiological evidence used in the paper, or whether this information is irrelevant, e.g., in the case of laboratory settings. 2. Data accessibility. A set-valued label recording the access mechanisms stated for the data used in the paper, or whether printed values permit limited in-paper reconstruction. 3. Data type. A multi-valued label capturing whether the contribution uses data and the nature of the data used for the contribution, i.e., whether it uses traditional data, non-traditional data Chafetz et al. (2022) , or synthetic data. 4. Paper type. One primary label used in evaluation, with optional secondary labels retained in the stored output, capturing the paper’s research-contribution type with respect to epidemiological parameter estimation.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 地理学. 一个设定值的标签,捕捉与论文中使用的流行病学证据有关的大陆,或者这些信息是否无关,例如在实验室设置的情况下. 2. 数据无障碍。 一个设定值的标签,记录了对纸张所使用数据所描述的存取机制,或者印刷值是否允许有限的纸张重建. 3. 数据类型。 多值标签记录贡献是否使用数据以及贡献所用数据的性质,即它是否使用传统数据,非传统数据Chafetz等(2022),或合成数据. 4. 纸张类型。 在评价中使用了一个主要标签,在所储存的产出中保留了可选的次要标签,在流行病学参数估计方面记录了论文的研究贡献类型。

blocks.en: Geography. A set-valued label capturing the continents associated with the epidemiological evidence used in the paper, or whether this information is irrelevant, e.g., in the case of laboratory settings.
blocks.zh: 地理学. 一个设定值的标签,捕捉与论文中使用的流行病学证据有关的大陆,或者这些信息是否无关,例如在实验室设置的情况下.

blocks.en: Data accessibility. A set-valued label recording the access mechanisms stated for the data used in the paper, or whether printed values permit limited in-paper reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 数据无障碍. 一种设定值的标签,记录纸上对所使用数据说明的存取机制,或者印刷值是否允许有限的纸上重建.

blocks.en: Data type. A multi-valued label capturing whether the contribution uses data and the nature of the data used for the contribution, i.e., whether it uses traditional data, non-traditional data Chafetz et al. (2022) , or synthetic data.
blocks.zh: 数据类型. 多值标签记录贡献是否使用数据以及贡献所用数据的性质,即它是否使用传统数据,非传统数据Chafetz等(2022),或合成数据.

blocks.en: Paper type. One primary label used in evaluation, with optional secondary labels retained in the stored output, capturing the paper’s research-contribution type with respect to epidemiological parameter estimation.
blocks.zh: 纸型. 在评价中使用了一个主要标签,在所储存的产出中保留了可选的次要标签,在流行病学参数估计方面记录了论文的研究贡献类型。

blocks.en:
Labels are assigned exclusively based on information provided within the document, disregarding external knowledge or verification.
For instance, if a paper states that its data are available in an online repository, we use that statement regardless of whether the repository is still accessible.
This is motivated by the fact that we focus on extraction fidelity, not on, for example, verifying data accessibility.
The only exception is the mapping of geographic locations to continents.
Here we allow the model to map a location to its geographic label using its internal knowledge, e.g., mapping a nation to its continent, providing guidance only for the ambiguous cases discussed below.
blocks.zh:
标签的指定完全基于文件中提供的信息,而不顾外部知识或核查。
例如,如果一份文件说其数据可在在线存储库中获取,我们使用该声明,而不论该存储库是否仍可访问。
这是因为我们注重提取忠诚,而不是例如核查数据的可获取性。
唯一的例外是将地理位置测绘到各大洲。
在此,我们允许该模型利用其内部知识,如将一个国家绘制到其大陆,将一个地点绘制在地理标签上,仅为下文讨论的模棱两可的情况提供指导。

blocks.en: Geography, data type, and paper type include an UNCLEAR fallback for insufficient evidence, distinct from IRRELEVANT (geography) and OTHER (paper type).
blocks.zh: 地理、数据类型和纸张类型包括UNCLE因证据不足而倒置,有别于地理和其他(纸张类型)。

blocks.en: 9.2 Geographic labelling
blocks.zh: 9.2 地理标签

blocks.en:
This pipeline is intended as a first-stage, high-recall filter for identifying subsets of papers that merit subsequent, more specialized analyses.
Accordingly, we adopt an intentionally inclusive definition of geographic information: we include all locations that are explicitly tied to the epidemiological evidence used in the paper, even when multiple plausible “geographic perspectives” coexist (e.g., location of exposure vs. location of detection/ascertainment).
For instance, when infections are acquired in one country but cases are detected, diagnosed, or reported in another, we include both locations in the multi-label GEO output.
We do not include a location mentioned only incidentally: if a paper analyses an outbreak in continent A and merely notes similar patterns in continent B, the correct label is A alone.
More granular labelling (e.g., separating exposure from ascertainment into distinct labels) is feasible, but is beyond our current aim.
blocks.zh:
这一管道是作为第一阶段的高召回过滤器,用于确定值得随后进行更专业分析的文件子集。
因此,我们通过一个有意识的包容性的地理信息定义:我们包括所有与文件中使用的流行病学证据明确挂钩的地点,即使存在多种可能存在的“地理视角”(例如接触地点与检测/确定地点)。
例如,如果在一个国家感染,但在另一个国家发现、诊断或报告病例,我们就把这两个地点都列入多标签的全球环境展望产出。
我们不包括仅偶然提到的地点:如果一份文件分析A大陆的爆发,而仅仅指出B大陆的类似情况,正确的标签是A。
更多的颗粒状标签(例如,将接触与确定区分成不同的标签)是可行的,但超出了我们目前的目标。

blocks.en:
There are, however, cases in which location information is considered irrelevant.
If the analysis is conducted entirely in controlled laboratory settings such that geographic or ecological variation is not meaningful (e.g., laboratory-bred animals or strictly controlled experimental conditions), the GEO axis is marked as IRRELEVANT .
The same label applies when the paper relies on purely synthetic or otherwise non-geographic data that is not meaningfully tied to any real-world location.
By contrast, wildlife, farm, market, household, and other field-like settings are treated as geographically meaningful and are labeled using the corresponding locations stated by the authors.
blocks.zh:
然而,在有些情况下,地点信息被认为无关紧要。
如果分析完全在受控制的实验室环境中进行,以致地理或生态变化无意义(如实验室饲养的动物或严格控制的实验条件),则地球同步轨道轴标为IRREELEVANT。
当纸张依赖纯合成数据或其他非地理数据,而这些数据与任何现实世界地点没有有意义的联系时,也适用同样的标签。
相比之下,野生生物、农场、市场、家庭和其他类似野外环境则被视为具有地理意义,并使用作者所述的相应地点贴上标签。

blocks.en: Consistent with our general principle of relying only on stated information, we do not infer geographic origin from strain identifiers, sample naming conventions, or external domain knowledge unless the paper explicitly states the geographic origin in the text.
blocks.zh: 根据我们仅依赖所申报资料的一般原则,我们不从菌株识别器、样品命名惯例或外部域知识中推断出地理来源,除非该文件在案文中明确说明地理来源。

blocks.en:
The continent label set is Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and Oceania (together with IRRELEVANT and UNCLEAR ).
Some countries straddle two continents and are intrinsically ambiguous under informal conventions.
For these transcontinental cases we fix a single, reproducible country-to-continent assignment using the United Nations Statistics Division M49 standard (“Standard Country or Area Codes for Statistical Use”, Series M, No. 49) ( United Nations Statistics Division, 2026 ) , rather than ad hoc geopolitical or cultural criteria.
For transcontinental countries where the pathogens in scope, those with pandemic potential, have been reported, the annotation prompt uses fixed assignments: Russia to Europe, Egypt to Africa, and Turkey, Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan, Georgia, Armenia, and Cyprus to Asia.
blocks.zh:
大陆标签集是非洲、亚洲、欧洲、北美、南美和大洋洲(连同IRREVANT和UNCLEAR)。
有些国家跨越了两个大陆,在非正式公约下内在含糊不清。
对于这些洲际案例,我们使用联合国统计司的M49标准(“统计使用标准国家或地区代码”,第M辑,第49号)(联合国统计司,2026年),而不是特别的地缘政治或文化标准,确定单一、可复制的从国家到大陆的任务。
对于已报告具有大流行病可能性的病原体的跨洲国家,即俄罗斯向欧洲、埃及向非洲和土耳其、哈萨克斯坦、阿塞拜疆、格鲁吉亚、亚美尼亚和塞浦路斯向亚洲派遣固定任务。

blocks.en:
Other sources of ambiguity, such as no-longer-existing political entities (e.g., USSR, Yugoslavia) or politically disputed/recognition-dependent territories (e.g., Kosovo), are largely avoided in this setting because our evaluation targets continent-level labels.
By collapsing geographic mentions onto continents, we anchor the GEO axis to relatively stable, predominantly geographic reference entities, reducing sensitivity to changes in statehood, naming, or recognition.
Finally, for papers mentioning a global scope, we list all continents.
blocks.zh:
其他含糊不清的来源,例如不存在更长期的政治实体(如苏联、南斯拉夫)或政治上有争议/依赖承认的领土(如科索沃),基本上在这一背景下被避免,因为我们的评价针对的是大陆一级的标签。
地球同步轨道的轴线被固定在相对稳定、主要是地理参照实体之上,
最后,关于提及全球范围的文件,我们列出所有大陆。

blocks.en: 9.3 Data accessibility labelling
blocks.zh: 9.3 数据无障碍标签

blocks.en:
DAVAIL records what the paper states about access to each dataset and whether the paper prints enough values to meet the REPORTED re-aggregation rule.
It measures reported accessibility and in-paper reconstructability, not verified access or general dataset reusability.
blocks.zh:
DAVAIL记录了纸上关于访问每个数据集的内容,以及纸张是否打印出足够的数值,以达到报告ED重新汇总的规则.
它衡量报告的可访问性和纸上可重建性,而不是经核实的可访问性或一般数据集的可重复性。

blocks.en:
OPEN . The data are publicly available via a persistent identifier (e.g., DOI, accession number), a stable link to a repository, or by being fully released within the paper package (e.g., full line-lists or complete contingency tables) in a form sufficient for a third party to reconstruct the dataset for new analyses.
Mentions of supplementary material only qualify if they contain the specific, extractable data used for the work (the link/identifier must point to the underlying data supporting the results, not just be a “supplementary information exists” pointer). REPORTED . The dataset is not fully released, but the paper provides granular, extractable data values (e.g., detailed frequency tables, stratified counts, or partial time-series) that allow a third party to independently recompute at least one primary summary statistic used in the analysis (e.g., a frequency, proportion, or rate) from the reported values alone , without requiring access to unreported data or relying on the authors’ interpretive conclusions.
This label applies based on the richness of the in-paper reporting, regardless of whether the data source is internal or a third party. It does not imply access to the underlying dataset or the ability to reproduce the full analysis. REFERENCED . The data are attributed to a specifically identifiable third-party source (e.g., public health authorities, institutional databases, emergency dashboards, named public sources, other papers), but the paper provides neither a stable retrieval path for the source data nor sufficient detail to re-aggregate the data or re-use them as inputs for other analyses without relying on the author’s interpretation (i.e., fails the REPORTED re-aggregation criterion).
This data-thin reporting (limited to derived outputs like effect sizes, coefficients, or fitted model curves) prevents independent verification.
Vague attributions (e.g., "government data") do not qualify (lean towards NOT_STATED ). AVAILABLE_UPON_REQUEST . The paper explicitly provides a request-based mechanism, such as contacting the author, a data access committee, or a specific institutional process. CLOSED . The paper explicitly states that the data cannot be shared or are restricted due to legal, ethical, or licensing constraints, without providing an actionable access mechanism. NOT_STATED . The paper provides no data access statement, no repository link, no request mechanism, and no identifiable third-party attribution, while also failing to provide extractable values sufficient for REPORTED .
Statements that data were collected/generated, without an access mechanism and without re-aggregatable values, should be labeled NOT_STATED .

Precedence is applied within each dataset, after which the paper-level output is the union of the per-dataset labels.
For one dataset, use OPEN when a qualifying public route is stated. Otherwise use AVAILABLE_UPON_REQUEST when an actionable request route exists, and CLOSED for an explicit restriction without such a route.
If none applies, distinguish REPORTED from REFERENCED by the re-aggregation criterion, and use NOT_STATED when neither applies.

blocks.en: 9.3.1 Operational scope
blocks.zh: 9.3.1 业务范围

blocks.en:
The protocol is descriptive rather than a compliance assessment: it classifies what a paper states or prints, using categories adapted to the heterogeneous availability statements encountered across journals and communities.
Two rules make the categories operational for both annotation and prompting: OPEN requires a stable retrieval route or a reconstructable in-paper release, and REPORTED requires enough printed values to recompute at least one primary summary statistic.
blocks.zh:
协议是描述性的,而不是对遵守情况的评估:它使用适合不同期刊和社区的可用性说明的类别,对纸张说明或印刷品进行分类。
两项规则使这些类别既可用于注释,又可用于提示: OPEN需要稳定的检索路径或可重建的纸质发布,而报告ED则需要足够的印刷值来重算至少一个主摘要统计.

blocks.en: 9.4 Data type labelling
blocks.zh: 9.4 国家 数据类型标签

blocks.en:
The DTYPE labels identify the nature of the data used to support a paper’s contribution. DTYPE is set-valued because a paper can use several data types. The operational NO_EMPIRICAL_DATA output is exclusive and is used only when the contribution relies on neither empirical nor simulated data.
The traditional, health, mobility, economic, and sentiment categories build on the #Data4COVID19 Review Chafetz et al. (2022) . SYNTHETIC and NO_EMPIRICAL_DATA are extensions introduced for this corpus.
In a nutshell, NTD refers to information that is digitally captured, mediated, or observed through new instrumentation mechanisms, which is often privately held and repurposed for uses unrelated to its initial collection.
blocks.zh:
DTYPE 标签可以识别用于支持论文贡献的数据的性质. DTYPE是设定值的,因为一纸可以使用多个数据类型. 实用的NO_EMPIRICAL_DATA输出是独有的,只有在贡献既不依赖于经验数据也不依赖于模拟数据时才使用.
传统、健康、流动、经济和情绪类别以#Data4COVID19 Review Chafetz等(2022)为基础。 为本文书引入了SYNTHETIC和NO-EMPIRICAL-DATA。
简言之,NTD是指通过新的仪器机制以数字方式捕获、调解或观测到的信息,这种仪器通常被私人持有并重新用于与其最初收集无关的用途。

blocks.en:
TRADITIONAL when a paper relies on standard epidemiological and public-health data sources collected through established surveillance infrastructure, regardless of digital vs analog collection methods.
Examples include daily or weekly case counts from a national surveillance system, hospital admissions and deaths, and PCR- or antigen-confirmed test line lists. NON_TRADITIONAL_HEALTH novel or
non-standard health data sources that emerged outside traditional
public-health surveillance systems, such as: (i) digital patient data from large-scale electronic-health-record repositories, (ii) platform-facilitated self-reports and symptom proxies collected through apps or web platforms, (iii) wastewater surveillance as a community-level proxy for spread, and (iv) wearable or biometric signals. NON_TRADITIONAL_MOBILITY when the paper uses mobility data, understood as data describing the location of a device relative to people/landmarks in the physical world or to other devices.
This includes mobility signals derived from telecommunications (e.g., call detail records), location data from software development kits embedded in smartphone apps, GPS and vehicle traces, and proximity technologies (e.g., Bluetooth), when used as epidemiological proxies (e.g., population movement patterns, contact opportunities). NON_TRADITIONAL_SENTIMENT when the paper uses NTD intended to capture how individuals or groups perceive and interpret epidemic-related developments and interventions.
This category includes social-media, crowdsourced, app-based, and online-panel data used to track behaviour or perceptions rather than clinical infections. Conventional epidemiological surveys remain TRADITIONAL . NON_TRADITIONAL_ECONOMIC when a paper uses digitally captured or platform-mediated data describing the economic activity of individuals, groups, or organisations.
This category includes credit and debit card transaction data, open procurement/contracting data, and supply chain data. SYNTHETIC when simulated data is presented as evidence and support for claims.
We do not assign SYNTHETIC when simulations are used solely to illustrate model fit or calibration.
Examples include simulation-based evaluation of policy scenarios, model-based counterfactual projections, and sensitivity analyses where simulated outcomes support the main claim (versus a purely illustrative fit plot, for which we do not assign the label).
The distinction is based on whether what is produced there is considered data at all, rather than on whether it is synthetic. NO_EMPIRICAL_DATA when the paper relies on neither an empirical dataset nor simulated data as evidence.
Examples include a conceptual commentary on containment strategies without data and a theoretical derivation of a model without fitting or empirical evaluation.

blocks.en: 9.5 Paper type labelling
blocks.zh: 9.5 联合国 纸张类型标签

blocks.en:
PAPER_TYPE classifies each document by the kind of scientific contribution it makes to epidemiological parameter estimation.
Epidemiological research often integrates multiple tasks (collecting data, inferring parameters, and making forecasts) within a single workflow.
While usually focused around a main contribution, papers combine different types of contributions.
We address this by distinguishing between a paper’s primary contribution (the main scientific claim or deliverable) and any secondary contributions (supporting tasks that enable or accompany the primary contribution).
We therefore assign one primary label and may assign additional secondary labels as needed.
The same label set is used for both primary and secondary contributions.
blocks.zh:
PAPER_TYPE按对流行病学参数估计的科学贡献类型对每份文件进行分类.
流行病学研究常常将多个任务(收集数据,推断参数,作出预测)整合在一个单一的工作流程中.
论文通常侧重于主要贡献,但结合了不同类型的贡献。
我们通过区分论文的主要贡献(主要科学主张或交付品)和任何次要贡献(使主要贡献成为可能或与之相伴随的支助性任务)来解决这一问题。
因此,我们指定了一个主要标签,并可根据需要指定额外的次要标签。
初级和二级贡献都使用同样的标签。

blocks.en:
EMPIRICAL . The contribution is based on original empirical data collection , where claims rely on direct measurement from a clearly defined study population or sample.
Examples: observational cohort studies, case–control studies, cross-sectional surveys, randomized trials, surveillance reports, or data papers describing new datasets. INFERENCE . The contribution involves estimating parameters or reconstructing unobserved epidemic processes by fitting explicit statistical or mechanistic models to observed data.
Results depend on model structure and assumptions, not on direct measurement alone.
Examples: papers estimating R 0 R_{0} or generation time from case data, reconstructing transmission chains, performing phylodynamic inference, or estimating seroconversion rates from serological surveys. FORECAST . The contribution is prediction or scenario analysis : forward projections of epidemic trajectories, comparisons of intervention scenarios, or counterfactual simulations.
The outputs are projected future outcomes or policy comparisons under stated assumptions.
Examples: epidemic projections for policy planning, intervention scenario comparisons, or real-time forecasting submissions. SYNTHESIS . The contribution is a systematic synthesis of existing evidence using predefined search, selection, and appraisal criteria (e.g., meta-analyses or PRISMA-compliant systematic reviews).
Examples: quantitative meta-analyses pooling estimates across studies, or systematic reviews synthesizing evidence on transmission parameters or intervention effectiveness. METHODOLOGICAL . The contribution is the development, evaluation, or comparison of methods : new estimators, inference frameworks, identifiability analyses, software tools, or theoretical results about epidemic processes.
Examples: papers introducing novel inference algorithms, proving identifiability results, developing software packages, or deriving analytical results on epidemic thresholds. COMMENTARY . The contribution is discussion or interpretation without presenting new empirical estimates, model-based inference, or systematic evidence synthesis.
Examples include narrative literature reviews, perspective pieces on research priorities, and policy commentaries. We use OTHER when a paper does not fit any of the categories above.
In our analysis we focus on the primary contribution, making this a single-label classification task.
Secondary contributions are recorded but not used in the evaluation.

blocks.en: 10.3 A fully local deployment
blocks.zh: 第10.3条 完全就地部署

blocks.en:
The Nemotron results show that the workflow does not depend on a proprietary model, but Nemotron is still accessed through a third-party serving API.
We therefore test a stronger deployment claim: whether the classification workflow can run entirely on hardware controlled by the analyst once the corpus has been assembled.
We run the Paper Classifier with qwen2.5:32b-instruct , served locally through Ollama ( oll, 2023 ) , in two configurations.
blocks.zh:
尼莫特龙的结果显示工作流程并不依赖于专有模式,但尼莫特龙仍然通过第三方服务API访问.
因此,我们测试一个更强烈的部署主张:一旦装配完毕,分类工作流程是否能够完全运行在分析师控制的硬件上.
我们用 qwen2.5:32b-instruct 操作纸质分类器,通过 Ollama(Oll, 2023) 本地服务,分为两种配置.

blocks.en:
In the partially local configuration, generation runs locally while retrieval reuses the Gemini-embedded index used by the served models.
This holds the retrieval index fixed. Differences from the served configuration combine the generator, provider, and serving-stack effects.
In the fully local configuration, the same generator instead uses an index built locally with BAAI/bge-m3 , so parsing, embedding, retrieval, and generation in the classification workflow require no remote service.
Because the two indices use different encoders, they can retrieve different evidence, so we treat their comparison primarily as a comparison between deployment configurations rather than as a direct measurement of embedding quality.

因为这两个指数使用不同的编码器,所以它们可以取回不同的证据,所以我们主要把他们的比较作为部署配置的比较,而不是直接衡量嵌入质量.

blocks.en: 10.3.1 Task-level performance
blocks.zh: 10.3.1 任务一级的业绩

blocks.en:
The effect of moving to the fully local stack is strongly task dependent rather than uniform.
Performance remains close to Flash on geography ( 0.869 0.869 versus 0.875 0.875 ) and remains high on data type ( 0.861 0.861 versus 0.916 0.916 ), although the majority baseline there is already 0.843 0.843 .
The largest gap occurs on data accessibility , where the fully local configuration reaches 0.539 0.539 , compared with 0.670 0.670 for Flash and 0.802 0.802 for Pro.
This is consistent with the earlier results identifying accessibility as the axis that places the greatest demands on both locating and interpreting evidence.
blocks.zh:
移动到完全本地堆栈的效果强烈依赖于任务而不是统一.
其性能仍然接近于地理学闪电(0.869 0.869比0.875 0.875),在数据类型上仍然很高(0.861 0.861比0.916 0.916),尽管那里的大多数基线已经是0.843 0.843.
最大的差距发生在数据的可访问性上,完全局部配置达到0.539 0.539,而Flash的0.670 0.670和Pro的0.802 0.802。
这与早先的结果是一致的,这些结果确定无障碍是确定和解释证据的最大要求轴心。

blocks.en:
The comparison with the supervised grid is similarly differentiated ( Table 3 and Section 11.5 ).
Without using training labels, the fully local configuration exceeds the grid’s best per-task score on geography ( 0.869 0.869 versus 0.771 0.771 ), matches it on paper type ( 0.794 0.794 versus 0.785 0.785 ), and remains below it on data type ( 0.861 0.861 versus 0.898 0.898 ) and data accessibility ( 0.539 0.539 versus 0.619 0.619 ). These maxima are an oracle ceiling assembled from different supervised configurations by task, not one deployable model.
Thus, a mid-sized local model retains much of the classification performance of the served workflow, with the largest cost concentrated on the axis that is already the most difficult in the main evaluation.
blocks.zh:
与监督网网的比较也有类似的差别(表3和第11.5节)。
在不使用训练标签的情况下,完全本地配置就超过了网格在地理上的最佳每任务分数(0.869 0.869比0.771 0.771),在纸张类型上与之相匹配(0.794 0.794比0.785 0.785),在数据类型(0.861 0.861比0.898 0.898)和数据可访问性(0.539 0.539比0.619 0.619)上仍然低于. 这些最大值是一个神谕天花板,由不同的受监督的配置按任务组合而成,而不是一个可部署的模式.
因此,一个中型的当地模式保留了所服务的工作流程的大部分分类性能,最大的成本集中在轴上,而在主要评价中已经是最困难的.

blocks.en: 10.3.2 Effect of local embedding
blocks.zh: 10.3.2 国家 本地嵌入的效果

blocks.en:
Moving the remaining embedding step on-device has only a small effect on downstream classification in this experiment.
Across the four axes, the partially and fully local configurations differ in Jaccard by at most 0.024 0.024 , and the direction is not consistently negative.
The fully local configuration scores higher on geography ( 0.869 0.869 versus 0.854 0.854 ) and paper type ( 0.794 0.794 versus 0.785 0.785 ), and lower on data type ( 0.861 0.861 versus 0.875 0.875 ) and data accessibility ( 0.539 0.539 versus 0.563 0.563 ).
In these experiments, replacing the Gemini-embedded index with a locally constructed one therefore contributes little to the downstream performance difference between the local and served configurations.
This does not establish that the two embedding models have equivalent retrieval quality, but it shows that removing the remote embedding dependency has little effect on the classification metrics considered here.
blocks.zh:
将剩余的嵌入步骤移入到装置上,对本实验中的下游分类只产生很小的影响.
在整个四个轴上,部分和完全的局部配置在Jaccard中差异最多为0.024 0.024,方向并非始终为负.
全地配置在地理学(0.869 0.869比0.854 0.854)和纸型(0.794 0.794比0.785 0.785)的分数较高,在数据类型(0.861 0.861比0.875 0.875)和数据无障碍(0.539 0.539比0.563 0.563)的分数较低.
因此,在这些实验中,用当地建造的双子嵌入指数取代双子嵌入指数,对当地配置和服务配置之间的下游性能差异作用不大。
这并不确定两个嵌入模型具有等同的检索质量,但它表明去除远程嵌入依赖性对本文所考虑的分类度量度度度度影响不大.

blocks.en: 10.3.3 Run-to-run repeatability
blocks.zh: 10.3.3 运行中的重复性

blocks.en:
Both self-hosted configurations were exactly repeatable at T = 0 T{=}0 in our experiments.
Across five independent executions, they returned identical label sets for every paper on all four axes, giving exactly zero standard deviation in Tables 3 and 5 .
For the fully local configuration, the repeats also agree on the generated text, retrieved evidence, and recorded prompt and completion token counts.
blocks.zh:
两种自备配置都完全可以重复在实验中T=0 T{=}0.
在5起独立处决中,他们归还了所有四轴上每份文件的同一套标签,在表3和表5中给出了完全零标准差。
对于完全本地化的配置,重复还商定生成的文本,取出的证据,以及记录的即时和完成符号计数.

blocks.en:
This differs from the API-served configurations, all of which retain non-zero run-to-run variation at T = 0 T{=}0 ( Tables 1 and 10.4 ).
Exact repeatability disappears when the temperature is raised to T = 1 T{=}1 , without a consistent gain in accuracy: data type improves slightly and geography is essentially unchanged, while paper type and data accessibility decline.
The repeatability observed at T = 0 T{=}0 should nevertheless be understood as a property of the specific deployment tested here rather than as a general guarantee of self-hosting.
Kernel choice, numerical precision, parallelism, and tensor reductions can all introduce variation even under greedy decoding.
What the experiment establishes is that controlling sampling and serving end to end was sufficient to obtain exact repeatability on this hardware and software stack, which is useful for an audit trail that may need to be regenerated later.
blocks.zh:
这不同于API-served配置,它们都保留了T=0 T{=}0(表1和10.4.)的非零跑到跑变.
准确的可重复性在温度被提升到T=1 TQQ1时消失,在准确性方面没有一致的增益:数据类型略有改善,地理学基本不变,而纸张类型和数据可获取性下降.
然而,在T=0 T{=}0中观察到的可重复性应理解为在此测试的具体部署的财产,而不是自我托管的一般保证。
内核选择,数值精度,并列性,和收分率的还原,即使在贪婪的解码下,都能够引入变异.
实验确定的是,控制取样和终端服务足以在这个硬件和软件堆栈上获得准确的可重复性,这对于日后可能需要再生成的审计线索是有用的.

blocks.en: 10.3.4 Corpus-scale classification
blocks.zh: 10.3.4 国家 公司规模分类

blocks.en:
Performance on the 214 214 -paper evaluation set establishes what the local deployment can recover where manual labels are available.
A separate deployment question is how its aggregate label distributions compare when the analysis is scaled to the complete corpus.
We therefore reran the three axes used for corpus-scale characterisation over all 2,297 papers with the fully local configuration at T = 0 T{=}0 .
Once the corpus had been assembled, no stage of this classification pass contacted a remote service.
blocks.zh:
214 214纸评价套案的绩效确定,在有人工标签的地方,当地部署可以恢复什么。
一个单独的部署问题,是当分析被缩放到完整体时,其总标签分布如何比较.
因此,我们重新提出三个轴,用于在所有2 297份文件上以T=0 T=0的完全局部配置进行实体化定性。
一旦装好炸弹,这一分类通行证没有与远程服务取得联系。

blocks.en: Figures 1 and 2 compare the served and fully local distributions. The served distributions come from one corpus run. Across five runs on the 214 214 -paper evaluation set, the largest spread in any label’s share was 2.3 2.3 percentage points ( 1.4 1.4 for paper type), although about one paper in ten changed its paper-type label.

blocks.en:
The two deployments produce similar aggregate distributions for geography and data type . This comparison of marginals does not establish paper-level agreement.
Every regional share differs by at most 7 7 percentage points and most differ by less than 3 3 , while the dominant Traditional share differs by less than 2 2 points ( 96.3 % 96.3\% served versus 94.5 % 94.5\% local).
The main divergence is paper type : the served model assigns Empirical to 57.7 % 57.7\% of the corpus, compared with 69.4 % 69.4\% under the local model.
blocks.zh:
这两项部署对地理和数据类型产生了类似的总分布。 边际的这种比较并不建立纸面协议.
每个地区份额最多相差7个百分点,最多相差不到3个百分点,而主要的传统份额相差不到2个百分点(96.3%96.3%服务于当地,94.5%94.5%服务于当地)。
主要差异是纸张类型:服务型分配了57.7%的委托书,而当地模式下分配了69.4%的69.4%。

blocks.en:
There are no manual labels for the full corpus, so this disagreement cannot be resolved directly at corpus scale.
The labelled evaluation sample nevertheless provides an informative diagnostic because it is drawn from the same corpus.
On that sample, the manual-label share of Empirical papers is 59.3 % 59.3\% , compared with 57.5 % 57.5\% for the served model and 68.7 % 68.7\% for the local model.
The corpus-scale difference therefore has the same direction and approximately the same magnitude as the difference observed where manual labels are available.
This is consistent with the corpus-scale shift reflecting the local model’s lower paper-type accuracy rather than a substantive difference in the underlying corpus.
blocks.zh:
没有全体的手动标签,因此这种分歧不能直接以体格解决.
不过,标有标签的评价样本提供了信息性诊断,因为它来自同一机构。
在该样本中,经验论文的人工标签份额为59.3% 59.3\%,而服务模型的人工标签份额为57.5% 57.5\%,当地模型的人工标签份额为68.7% 68.7\%。
因此,体积差别的方向和大小与可使用人工标签时观察到的差别大致相同。
这与反映当地模型较低纸张类型的准确性而非基本文书的实质性差异的体积变化是一致的。

blocks.en:
The local model predicts somewhat fewer geographic labels than the served model at corpus scale.
On the labelled sample, some of those lower frequencies are closer to the shares in the manually labelled sample.
Therefore, the difference between the two corpus-scale distributions should not automatically be interpreted as an error of the local model.
blocks.zh:
当地模型预测的地理标签略低于已使用模型的体积。
在贴有标签的样本上,一些较低的频率更接近手动贴有标签的样本中的股份.
因此,两个实体尺度分布之间的差异不应被自动解释为当地模型的错误。

blocks.en: The labelled sample therefore helps interpret the direction of aggregate differences, but only the evaluation-set accuracy metrics support model comparisons at paper level.
blocks.zh: 因此,标有标签的样本有助于解释总体差异的方向,但只有评价组合的精确度衡量标准支持纸面模型的比较。

blocks.en: 10.4 Stability and error diagnostics
blocks.zh: 10.4 稳定性和误差诊断

blocks.en:
These diagnostics complement the aggregate performance summaries in Section 4 and use the same fixed evaluation set of 214 214 papers.
Aggregate scores alone do not show whether different models fail on the same papers.

这些诊断补充了第4节的汇总性能摘要,并使用了同样的214 214份文件的固定评价集。
单是总分并不能显示不同的模型在同一论文上是否失败.

Tables 6 and 7 show that the ever-wrong sets overlap substantially.
