blocks.en: 11 Comparison baselines
blocks.zh: 11 比较基线

blocks.en:
This appendix details the methods, configurations, and statistical comparisons behind the baseline results in Sections 4.2.3 and 3 .
The families differ fundamentally in what they require and what they measure, so they are read here not as a homogeneous leaderboard but as a map of what each kind of method can and cannot do on this task.
blocks.zh:
本附录第4.2.3和3节详述基线结果背后的方法、配置和统计比较。
家庭在需要什么和衡量什么方面有着根本的不同,因此,他们在这里被理解为不是一模一样的领导板,而是各种方法能够和不能完成这项任务的地图。

blocks.en:
The bottom line is this: across the four axes, EpiLens matches or exceeds the tested baselines while requiring no labelled training data.
The advantage is largest where the relevant evidence lies outside the title and abstract, indicating that the main contribution is not simply model choice but access to body-text evidence, with targeted retrieval mattering most for data accessibility ( Section 4.2.2 ).
On geography, whose signal is largely in the title and abstract, the advantage over the abstract-only LLM is small, although the margins over the supervised baselines are the largest of any axis ( Table 1 ).
blocks.zh:
底线是:跨越四轴,EpiLens匹配或超过被测试的基线,同时不需要有标签的培训数据.
如果相关证据在标题和抽象之外,其优势最大,表明主要贡献不仅仅是模型选择,而是获取正文证据,而目标检索对于数据的可获取性最为重要(第4.2.2节)。
在地理方面,其信号主要在标题和抽象中,相对于抽象的LLM而言,优势很小,尽管在受监督的基线上,边距是任何轴线中最大的(表1)。

blocks.en: 11.1 The design space and the methods we compare
blocks.zh: 第11.1条 设计空间和我们比较的方法

blocks.en: Classifying a literature into analytically useful categories admits methods that differ along two requirements that are easy to conflate ( Figure 1 ): whether the category scheme is specified by the analyst or discovered from the corpus , and whether the method needs manually labelled training examples before it can be applied.
blocks.zh: 将文献分类为分析性有用的类别,可以承认两种方法不同,容易合并(图1):类别方案是由分析员指明的还是从实体中发现的,以及该方法是否需要人工标记的培训实例才能适用。

blocks.en:
Figure 1: The design space of methods for classifying scientific literature. The map separates two choices: where the categories come from, and whether a labelled training set is required before the method can be used.
EpiLens occupies the analyst-specified, annotation-free cell: categories are written as natural-language descriptions and applied without task-specific training labels, and retrieval then grounds those decisions in paper evidence.
blocks.zh:
图 1:科学文献分类方法的设计空间. 地图分出两个选择:类别来自何处,以及是否在使用方法之前需要贴有标签的培训集.
EpiLens 占据了分析器指定的无注释单元格:类别作为自然语言描述来写出,并且在使用时没有特定任务的培训标签,然后检索将这些决定作为书面证据的依据。

blocks.en:
Unsupervised and guided topic models (latent semantic analysis (LSA) ( Deerwester et al., 1990 ) , probabilistic latent semantic analysis (PLSA) ( Hofmann, 1999 ) , latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA) ( Blei et al., 2003 ) , non-negative matrix factorisation (NMF) ( Lee and Seung, 1999 ) , standard BERTopic ( Grootendorst, 2022 ) , and seed-guided variants) need no labelled papers but infer themes from the corpus rather than applying a predefined scheme. They answer what structure a literature happens to exhibit, not how its papers fall under a fixed scheme.
Semi-supervised topic-model variants occupy a different position: they can use labelled papers to steer topic discovery, but their output remains corpus-inferred topics rather than direct predictions under the analyst’s coding scheme.
blocks.zh:
未经监督和指导的专题模型(在线语义分析(LSA)(Deerwester等,1990年),概率潜在语义分析(PLSA)(Hofmann,1999年),潜入的Drichlet分配(LDA等,2003年),非阴性矩阵因子化(NMF)(Lee和Eung,1999年),标准BERTOPIC(Grootendort,2022年)和种子导变种)不需要标有标签的论文,而需要从本体推断出的主题,而不是应用预先界定的办法。 他们回答一个文学所展示的结构,而不是它的论文如何属于一个固定的计划。
半监督主题模型变体具有不同的地位:它们可以使用标有标签的论文来引导主题的发现,但其产出仍然是实体推导的主题,而不是分析师编码方案下的直接预测.

blocks.en:
Supervised classifiers learn an analyst-specified scheme from labelled papers by pairing a representation of the text with a trained classifier head .
Rather than designate a single representative, we name three points in that space. TF-IDF + SVM , a term-frequency–inverse-document-frequency representation ( Sparck Jones, 1972 ) (each word weighted by how distinctive it is to a document) fed to a linear support vector machine ( Cortes and Vapnik, 1995 ) , is the classic lexical anchor. SetFit ( Tunstall et al., 2022 ) , which fine-tunes a sentence-embedding model on the labelled examples, is the fine-tuned neural representative. ModernBERT ( Warner et al., 2025 ) , an 8192 8192 -token long-context encoder applied to the parsed body text (overflow handled by window pooling), is the long-context body-text representative.
A calibrated prototype , which tunes only a single decision threshold, is the most minimal use of labels.
The full representation × \times text-scope × \times classifier-head grid behind these named points is swept in Section 11.5 .
blocks.zh:
受监督的分类人员从标有标签的文档中学习一个分析师特有的方案,方法是将文本的表述与训练有素的分类头配对。
我们不是指定一个代表,而是在该空间提出三点。 TF-IDF + SVM,一种名词-频率-反文档-频率表示法(Sparck Jones, 1972年)(每个单词按其与文档的区别而加权)被喂入线性支持向量机(Cortes and Vapnik, 1995年),是经典的词典主锚. SetFit (Tunstall等, 2022 ),它微调了标有标注的示例上的句子嵌入模型,是微调神经的代表. ModernBERT (Warner等, 2025), 一种适用于解析后正文文字的8192 8192-token长文编码器(由窗口集合处理的过量流),是长文正文文字的代表.
校正原型只调取一个决定阈值,是标签使用最少的.
完全表示 ×\times text-scope ×\times 这些命名点后面的分类器-头网格在第11.5节被横扫.

blocks.en:
Off-the-shelf zero-shot classifiers apply analyst-specified category descriptions without task-specific training labels.
In the NLI formulation, the input text is treated as a premise and each candidate label is verbalised as a hypothesis. The model then scores whether the premise entails the hypothesis ( Yin et al., 2019 ) .
In our runs, the premise is the paper title and abstract.
This aligns with the standard usage mode for zero-shot NLI classifiers.
We do not use the full-paper as premise because standard NLI models have a finite input window for scoring premise-hypothesis pairs which scientific papers often exceed.
We also evaluate a prototype similarity approach for zero-shot classification, which represents each label by a single prototype vector (the embedding of its description) and assigns the labels whose prototypes are closest to the paper’s own embedding.
blocks.zh:
现成零发分级器应用分析师指定类别描述,而不用特定任务训练标签.
在NLI配制中,输入文本被作为前提对待,每个候选标签被口头化为假设. 该模型然后对前提是否包含假说进行评分(Yin等,2019.
在我们的运行中,前提就是论文标题和抽象.
这符合零发NLI分类器的标准使用模式.
我们不使用全纸作为前提,因为标准NLI模型有一个有限的输入窗口,用于评分前提-假说对子,科学论文往往会超过。
我们还评价一种零发分级的原型相似性方法,它用单一原型向量代表每个标签(其描述的嵌入),并指定其原型最接近于纸张自嵌入的标签.

blocks.en:
EpiLens’s Paper Classifier occupies the position the others leave awkward: analyst-specified categories, revisable as text, applied with no training labels, and grounded in full-document evidence through retrieval.
A majority prior (always predicting the most common label set) provides a reference floor. Figure 1 maps these families and EpiLens’s place among them. The next section records how each method is configured and the role it plays. We then position them by what each requires against the accuracy it reaches.
blocks.zh:
EpiLens的纸张分类器占据了其他人留下的尴尬位置:分析师指定的类别,可修改为文本,没有训练标签地应用,并通过检索以完整的文件证据为基础。
多数先前(总是预测最常用的标签集)提供了参考底. 图1列出了这些家庭以及EpiLens在其中的位置。 下一节记录每种方法的配置及其作用. 然后,我按每种事物的要求,依其准确性而加以定位。

blocks.en: 11.2 Configuration and role of each method
blocks.zh: 11.2 每种方法的配置和作用

blocks.en:
Having placed each family in the design space ( Section 11.1 ), we now give the configuration and role of each method, grouped by family, so the comparisons that follow can be read against a fully specified set of baselines.
The majority prior sits outside these families as a reference floor rather than a method: it always predicts the most frequent label set (estimated leave-one-out to avoid leakage from the target paper’s own label), takes no text as input, and marks how much apparent performance follows from label skew alone.
blocks.zh:
在将每个家庭置于设计空间(第11.1节)之后,我们现在给出了按家庭分类的每一种方法的配置和作用,因此可以对照一套充分规定的基线来阅读随后的比较。
大部分前辈都坐在这些家庭之外,作为参考底线而不是一种方法:它总是预测最频繁的标签集(为避免从目标文件自己的标签上漏出而估计的一出),不以文字作为输入,并标出仅从标签skew中就可以看出多少明显的性能。

blocks.en: 11.2.1 Zero-shot baselines
blocks.zh: 11.2.1 零射入射基线

blocks.en:
Zero-shot classifier baselines assign papers to an analyst-specified label set without training on manually annotated examples from the task.
Here we use the term for two retrieval-free, annotation-free classifiers: a prototype-similarity classifier whose label representations are built from the coding protocol, and an off-the-shelf NLI classifier that scores verbalised label hypotheses against the paper metadata.
Both operate on title and abstract only. Calibrated variants that tune thresholds on manual labels are reported with the supervised baselines.
blocks.zh:
0射入分级基线将文件分配给一个分析师指定的标签,而不对任务中手动附加说明的例子进行培训。
这里我们用这个词来表示两个无检索,无注释的分类器:一个是原型-同义分类器,其标签表示由编码协议所构建;另一个是现成的NLI分类器,对照纸质元数据对口语化的标签假设进行分数.
两者都只以标题和抽象方式运作。 手动标签上调值阈值的校准变体随监督基线报告。

blocks.en:
Each label is represented by a prototype vector: the embedding of its definition text where the coding protocol provides one (paper type, data type, data accessibility), and of the label name otherwise (geography).
At inference the paper’s title and abstract are embedded in the same space and scored by cosine similarity to each prototype.
We use two representations: a sparse TF-IDF space and a dense one from allenai-specter , a sentence transformer trained on scientific-paper pairs.
The choice of representation matters for what “similarity” means. With TF-IDF the label prototype is essentially its own words, so the method reduces to lexical overlap between the abstract and the label text. For geography, where the prototype is just the continent name, this is close to detecting whether the abstract literally mentions that region. The dense SPECTER prototype relaxes this to semantic similarity, which is why it helps on the axes with descriptive definitions more than on the name-only geography axis.
Assignment uses a relative rule rather than a single absolute cutoff: a label is kept if its similarity is at least a fraction τ rel = 0.92 \tau_{\text{rel}}{=}0.92 of the top-scoring label’s similarity, above an absolute floor τ ≥ 0.03 \tau{\geq}0.03 , and among the top three.
The uncalibrated regime uses these defaults and needs no labels, so it is a genuinely annotation-free zero-shot baseline. The calibrated regime instead selects the absolute floor τ \tau per fold by 5-fold cross-validation (maximising mean Jaccard on the other folds, over a grid of score quantiles that includes the default), holding the relative rule fixed. This uses labels, so it counts as a minimal supervised method reported with the supervised baselines.
Because the default is among the candidates, calibration cannot underperform it on the selection folds, though held-out performance may still be lower.
Calibration recovers part of the gap on the multi-label tasks ( Table 3 ). Paper type , single-label and decided by arg-max, has no threshold to tune.
Even calibrated, the prototype stays below the discriminative supervised classifiers, because a single global acceptance rule cannot capture per-label decision boundaries.
blocks.zh:
每个标签由原型向量代表:在编码协议提供一种(纸张类型,数据类型,数据可访问性)时嵌入其定义文本;另加标签名称(地理学).
在推论中,纸张的标题和抽象都嵌入在同一空间,并以与每个原型相近的余弦来打分.
我们使用两种表达方式:一个稀少的TF-IDF空间和一个密集的Alenai-specter空间,一个受过科学纸对训练的句子变压器.
代表权的选择对“同等性”的含义很重要。 与TF-IDF相比,标签原型本质上是自己的单词,因此该方法将抽象文本和标签文本相去甚远地缩小为词汇重叠. 对于地理学来说,原型只是大陆名称,这接近于检测抽象字面上是否提到那个区域. 稠密的SPECTER原型可以将这个放松到语义上的相似性,这就是为什么它用描述性定义来帮助轴上而不是只用名称的地理学轴上.
指定使用相对规则而不是单一的绝对截断:如果标签的相似性至少是分数 \\ rel = 0.92\ text{ rel\ 0.92 上评分标签的相似性,在绝对下限 \ 0.03\ tau\ geq} 0.03 以上,并在前三分中保留.
未校正的制度使用这些默认,不需要标签,因此它是一个真正无注释的零发基线. 校正制度则选择每折叠5倍的绝对下限 \ tau(其他折叠上最大值的平均值为Jaccard,在包含默认值的分数方格上),维持固定的相对规则。 这使用了标签,因此,它算作一种与受监督基线一起报告的最低限度的受监督方法。
由于缺省在候选者中,校正在选取折叠上不能表现不佳,尽管被搁置的成绩可能仍然较低.
校正回收了多标签任务上的部分缺口(表3 )。 纸张类型 单标签和由arg-max决定,没有调取的阈值.
即使经过校正,原型仍会停留在有区别的受监督分级器以下,因为一个单一的全球接受规则无法捕捉到每个标签的决定边界.

blocks.en:
Following the standard zero-shot text-classification recipe ( Yin et al., 2019 ) , each candidate label is framed as a natural-language-inference hypothesis (“This paper is about {label}.”), and an NLI-fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-base checkpoint ( MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli ( He et al., 2023 ; Laurer, 2026 ) ) scores the entailment of each hypothesis against the paper’s title and abstract. Labels clearing an entailment threshold are kept (the highest-scoring label for the single-label paper type task).
This is the most direct off-the-shelf occupant of EpiLens’s design-space quadrant (analyst-specified yet annotation-free), but, as we run it, it reads only the title and abstract and reasons one label at a time.
Its behaviour is highly uneven across axes. We analyse why in Section 11.3.1 .
This unevenness does not appear to be caused by an obviously weak hypothesis template. We tested a task-specific template (“This paper uses label data”), but it did not recover Traditional and increased over-prediction of non-traditional labels.
Replacing label names with one-sentence definitions from the coding protocol ( Section 9 ) also lowered scores on most tasks, suggesting that the NLI model is sensitive to hypothesis wording and does not reliably apply the full coding protocol from metadata alone.
We therefore report the stronger label-name variant.
blocks.zh:
遵循标准的零发文本分类法(Yin等,2019年),每个候选标签被设定为自然语言推论假说. ((“本文约为{label}.”)和NLI-fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-base检查站(Moritz Laurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli) (He等, 2023; Laurer, 2026))根据论文的标题和抽象来评分每个假设的必然性. 标记清除一个内含阈值(单标签纸张类型任务的最高得分标签)被保留.
这是EpiLens设计-空间四象限最直接的现成占取者(分析-指定但无注释),但当我们运行时,它只读取标题和抽象,并解释一个标签的原因。
其行为在各轴之间极不平衡. 我们分析第11.3.1节中的原因。
这种不均衡似乎不是由一个明显薄弱的假说模板所造成. 我们测试了一个针对特定任务的模板(“本文使用标签数据”),但没有恢复传统和增加的对非传统标签的过度预测。
从编码协议(第9节)中用一刑定义来取代标签名称,也降低了大多数任务的分数,表明NLI模型对假说措辞敏感,不可靠地仅从元数据应用了完整的编码协议.
因此,我们报告较强的标签名称变体。

blocks.en: 11.2.2 Guided and semi-supervised topic-model baselines
blocks.zh: 11.2.2 指导性和半监督性专题模式基线

blocks.en:
BERTopic represents documents with transformer embeddings, clusters them in a reduced space, and labels each cluster with class-based TF–IDF descriptors ( Grootendorst, 2022 ) . Its native output is a set of corpus-inferred topics, not assignments to an analyst-defined taxonomy.
In its plain, unlabelled form it is therefore a pure corpus-structure probe: it asks how far each axis separates from corpus-level vocabulary structure with no label information at all. In that form BERTopic is one of the topic models in the corpus-structure audit ( Section 11.6 ), which is where we report that recoverability question.
blocks.zh:
BERTOPIC代表带有变压器嵌入的文档,将其分组在一个缩小的空间中,并用基于分级的TF-IDF描述符(Grootendorst, 2022)给每个集群贴上标签. 其原生产出是一套由实体推导的专题,而不是分配给分析师定义的分类学。
因此,在其平坦、无标签的形态中,它是一个纯实体结构探测器:它询问每个轴与实体一级词汇结构分离到底有多远,根本没有标签信息。 这种形式的BERTOPIC是机构-结构审计(第11.6节)中的主题模型之一,我们报告的是可回收性问题。

blocks.en:
The guided and semi-supervised variants differ in the kind of analyst input they consume.
The guided variant supplies seed terms drawn from each label definition, biasing topic discovery toward the target concepts while leaving the discovered topics free to merge, split, or ignore the labels.
It therefore uses analyst guidance but not labelled training papers.
The semi-supervised variant instead passes the manual labels of the training papers, using partial document-level supervision to steer the clustering.
blocks.zh:
被引导和半监督的变体在它们所消耗的分析师投入种类上有所不同.
制导变体提供从每个标签定义中抽取的种子术语,将专题发现偏向目标概念,同时让已发现的专题自由合并、分拆或忽略标签。
因此,它使用分析指导,但没有标明培训文件。
半监督的变体转而通过培训文件的人工标签,使用部分文件层面的监督来指导分组.

blocks.en:
For this reason the two variants occupy different rows of Figure 1 .
Guided BERTopic remains annotation-free with respect to paper labels and belongs with the topic-model family: the analyst supplies seeds, but the emitted topics remain corpus-inferred and must be interpreted or aligned after the fact.
Semi-supervised BERTopic belongs in the labelled-papers row, because it consumes manual labels for training papers, but it still remains in the corpus-inferred column rather than the analyst-specified classifier column: labels steer the clustering, whereas the output is still a set of topics that need not correspond one-to-one to the coding scheme.
The contrast with supervised classifiers is therefore not whether labels can influence the method, but how they enter: a supervised head learns a decision boundary that maps text directly onto the fixed label set, whereas guided or semi-supervised topic modelling uses seeds or labels to bias topic discovery.
blocks.zh:
因此,两个变体占据了图1的不同行.
指导性BERTOPIC对于纸质标签仍然没有注释,属于主题模型家族:分析师提供种子,但所排放的专题仍然受到实体影响,必须事后加以解释或调整。
半被监督的BERTOPIC属于被贴上标签的纸行,因为它消耗了训练论文的手动标签,但是它仍然停留在被赋予的活体柱上,而不是分析师指定的分类器柱上:标签引导集群,而输出仍然是一组不需要与编码方案对应的话题.
因此,与被监管的分类器的对比不是标签能否影响方法,而是它们是如何输入的:被监管头学习到一个决定边界,将文本直接映射到固定的标签集上,而被引导或半被监管的专题建模则使用种子或标签来偏向主题发现.

blocks.en:
These topic-model variants answer a different question from EpiLens: not whether a fixed coding protocol can be applied directly to each paper, but whether the label axes align with separable corpus structure once discovery is nudged toward the target concepts.
We report these guided and semi-supervised topic-model variants in Table 3 . To avoid tying the comparison to a single topic granularity, we sweep the requested number of topics over K ∈ { 0.5 , 1 , 2 , 4 } × | ℒ | K\in\{0.5,\,1,\,2,\,4\}\times|\mathcal{L}| and report the best-aligned configuration.
blocks.zh:
这些主题-模型变体回答了一个与EpiLens不同的问题:不是固定的编码协议能否被直接应用于每份文件,而是在发现后向目标概念倾斜时,标签轴是否与可分离体结构一致.
我们在表3中报告了这些指导性和半监督性的专题模型变体。 为避免将比较与单个主题颗粒性相匹配,我们将所要求的主题数扫到 K {{ { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { L } { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { > { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { { {

blocks.en: 11.2.3 Supervised baselines
blocks.zh: 第11.2.3条 监督基线

blocks.en:
Supervised baselines all follow one recipe: pair a representation of the text with a trained classifier head , fit on the manual labels under cross-validation.
Within that recipe they differ in one methodologically important way, where the label signal enters .
In most of them the representation is fixed independently of the labels, either unsupervised (the sparse TF-IDF space) or a frozen pretrained encoder whose weights are never updated, and the labels train only the head on top: there is no gradient path from the head’s loss back into the representation, which reaches the head as a fixed feature matrix.
SetFit is the sole exception, letting the labels also reshape the representation by contrastively fine-tuning the encoder before a head is fit on the adapted embeddings.
Even there the encoder and head are fit in separate stages, not by one joint objective, so no baseline here is end-to-end fine-tuned in the sense of gradients flowing through encoder and classifier together. Jointly training and tuning a full encoder and classifier across four tasks would be disproportionate to an evaluation with only 214 214 manually labelled papers and would also carry a high risk of overfitting.
We surface three named points, and Section 11.5 sweeps the full representation × \times scope × \times head grid behind them: TF-IDF + SVM (classic lexical, head-only supervision), SetFit (the one representation-adapting encoder), and ModernBERT (frozen long-context body-text encoder).
All are trained and evaluated by cross-validation over the N = 214 N{=}214 papers (using iterative multi-label stratification for the set-valued axes where feasible, to balance label prevalence across folds), on the title+abstract scope shared with the other abstract-scoped methods. ModernBERT is the exception, applied to the parsed body text.
We additionally report TF-IDF under leave-one-out as a robustness variant.
Together they establish how far label-supervised text classification reaches, as a reference for the contribution of retrieval-grounded reasoning.
blocks.zh:
监督的基线都遵循一种方法:将文本的表示与经过训练的分类头配对,在交叉验证的手动标签上贴上。
在这个食谱中,它们以一种方法上的重要方式不同,即标签信号输入的地方。
在其中大多数中,代表是独立于标签的固定的,要么是无监督的(稀有的TF-IDF空间),要么是从未更新过重量的被冷冻的前置编码器,标签只在上方训练头部:没有从头部损失回向代表的梯度路径,它作为固定特征矩阵到达头部.
SetFit是唯一的例外,让标签在一个头被安装在被调整的嵌入物上之前,通过相向的微调来重塑表示.
即使在那里,编码器和头部也处于独立的相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相位相相 联合培训和调整一个全编码器和分类器,涉及四项任务,这与只有214 214份手工标注文件的评价不相称,而且具有过度调整的高风险。
我们浮出三个被命名点,第11.5节将全代表X\times specification ×\times ×\times 后头网格: TF-IDF + SVM(经典名词法,只头监理),SetFit(一个代表-适应编码器)和ModernBERT(被冻结的长文正文编码器).
所有这些文件都经过N=214 N{=}214文件的交叉验证(在可行的情况下对设定值轴使用迭接多标签分层,以平衡跨折叠的标签普遍度)的训练和评价,其标题+抽象范围与其他抽象范围方法共用. 现代 BERT是例外,适用于被解析的正文.
此外,我们报告TF-IDF在 " 一停 " 下是一个强性变体。
它们共同确定标签监督文本分类达到多大程度,作为检索依据推理的贡献的参考。

blocks.en:
The classical anchor and simplest instance of the recipe, and a pure case of head-only supervision: a sparse TF-IDF representation of the title and abstract (each term weighted by how distinctive it is to a document), built from corpus term statistics without ever seeing the labels, is fed to a linear support vector machine that is the only trained component, under stratified 5-fold cross-validation with leave-one-out as a robustness variant ( Table 3 ).
It is the strongest non-neural reference and, on the lexically regular axes, the closest baseline to EpiLens.
blocks.zh:
食谱的古典锚地和最简单的例子,以及纯粹的只靠头的监管案例:一个稀少的TF-IDF代表标题和抽象(每个术语按其与文件的不同程度加以加权),从实体术语统计中构建而来,从未看到标签,它被喂入一个线性支持矢量机,这是唯一经过训练的部件,在分层5倍的交叉验证下,以一个一出作为强性变量(表3)。
它是最强的非神经参照物,在逻辑正轴上最接近于EpiLens的基线.

blocks.en:
SetFit ( Tunstall et al., 2022 ) is a supervised, label-efficient text-classification method that first fine-tunes a sentence-transformer on pairs of labelled examples with a contrastive objective, then trains a classification head on the resulting embeddings.
It is thus the one supervised baseline here in which the labels reach the representation itself, not only the head, though the contrastive fine-tuning and the head are still fit in separate stages rather than by a single joint objective.
We use sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 as the base encoder and evaluate it under stratified 5-fold cross-validation across the N = 214 N{=}214 evaluation papers.
We do not use leave-one-out here, since it would need a separate fine-tuning run for each held-out paper.
To cap the number of contrastive pairs drawn from our relatively large cross-validation folds, we set num_iterations = 2 {=}2 instead of the default sampling strategy.
Text scope is restricted to title and abstract.
This is also the natural scope for the chosen sentence-transformer: all-mpnet-base-v2 is intended for sentence- and short-paragraph embeddings, and its default sentence-transformers configuration truncates inputs longer than a few hundred word pieces.
Applying it to the full body would therefore require either truncation or a separate chunk-level pooling rule to aggregate window embeddings into a paper-level prediction.
blocks.zh:
SetFit(Tunstall等,2022年)是一种有监督的,标签效率高的文本分类方法,它首先对一对标有对比性目标的有标签的例子上的句子转换器进行微调,再在所生嵌入物上训练一个分类头.
因此,它是一个监督的基准,在这个基准中,标签到达代表本身,而不仅仅是头部,尽管对比性微调和头部仍然处于不同的阶段,而不是由一个共同的目标。
我们使用句子转换器/全通网-base-v2作为基准编码器,并在分级的5倍交叉验证下通过N=214 N{=}214的评价文件进行评审.
我们这里不使用"一出",因为它需要为每份被搁置的纸张单独进行微调.
为了限制从我们相对较大的交叉验证折叠中抽取的对比对的数量,我们设定了num_iterations = 2 {=}2,而不是默认的采样策略.
文本范围限于标题和抽象。
这也是所选句子-变音器的自然范围:All-mpnet-base-v2用于句子-和短段嵌入,而其默认句子-变音器的配置会比几百个单词片段长出输入.
因此,将它应用到整个体上,将需要截取或单独的块级集合规则来将聚合窗口嵌入到纸张级的预测中。

blocks.en:
ModernBERT ( Warner et al., 2025 ) is a bidirectional encoder trained with a native 8192 8192 -token sequence length, substantially longer than the few-hundred-token windows of the other dense encoders.
We apply it as a frozen feature extractor under the same stratified 5-fold protocol as the other supervised baselines, with its weights never updated (as for the other dense encoders here): each body window is encoded with the encoder held fixed, token embeddings are mean-pooled to obtain a window representation, and these fixed representations are passed to a separately trained MLP classification head.
For papers whose parsed body fits within the 8192 8192 -token window, this gives a single body-level representation. For longer papers, we encode multiple windows and mean-pool their representations rather than truncating the body ( Section 11.5 ).
ModernBERT is therefore the supervised baseline with the widest body-text scope, testing how far a frozen long-context encoder’s features, with only the head trained, can go without label-targeted retrieval.
blocks.zh:
现代贝特 (Warner等,2025年)是一个双向编码器,训练有原生的8192 8192 - 托肯序列长度,大大长于其他密集编码器的几百个托肯窗口.
我们在与其他被监督的基线相同的分级5倍协议下将其作为被冻结的特性提取器应用,其分量从未更新(如这里的其他密集编码器):每个机体窗口被被固定的编码器所编码,符号嵌入被平均集合以获得窗口代表,这些被固定的表示被传递给一个经过单独训练的MLP分类头.
对于身体符合8192 8192-托起窗口的论文,这给出了单一的体位代表. 对于较长的论文,我们编码多个窗口,并平均汇集其表述,而不是截取身体(第11.5节)。
因此,ModernBERT是范围最广的有监督的基线,测试一个被冷冻的长文本编码器的特性,只有头部经过训练,在不进行标有标签的检索的情况下能够走多远。

blocks.en: 11.2.4 RAG ablation baselines
blocks.zh: 11.2.4 RAG减震基线

blocks.en: Three variants of the same workflow (metadata only, random chunks, and the whole body) join full EpiLens in the four-condition ablation of Section 4.2.2 .
blocks.zh: 同一工作流程的三个变体(只元数据,随机块,和整个正体)在4.2.2节的四条件通缩中加入全EpiLens.

blocks.en:
Runs the same language model with the same classification prompts as EpiLens, but replaces retrieved full-text evidence with only the paper’s title and abstract.
This directly isolates the contribution of retrieval: any performance gap between this baseline and the full system is attributable to the retrieved body-text passages.
It is given the raw parsed metadata (title and abstract) and never any body text, keeping it a clean ablation of retrieval. For the 32 32 papers with no machine-readable abstract it therefore sees the title alone, exactly as the other abstract-scoped baselines do. The paper is not skipped, so all 214 214 are scored on the same set as the full-text system.
blocks.zh:
运行与 EpiLens 相同的分类提示的同一种语言模型,但将检索到的全文证据取而代之的只有纸张的标题和抽象.
这直接隔离了检索的贡献:这一基线和整个系统之间的任何性能差距都归因于检索到的正文段落.
它被赋予原始解析的元数据(标题和抽象),并且从来没有任何正文文本,保持了它对于检索的清空. 对于32份没有机器可读抽象的论文,它因此只看到标题,正像其他抽象的基线那样。 报纸没有跳过,所以所有214 214都是在与全文系统相同的套上打分.

blocks.en:
Runs the same model and prompts as the full system, but selects k k body-text passages by uniform random sampling from the per-paper document pool in the vector index rather than by semantic similarity to the template paragraphs.
This holds body-text access fixed while ablating retrieval quality, thereby isolating the contribution of targeted retrieval from the contribution of body-text access per se.
blocks.zh:
运行与完整系统相同的模型并提示,但通过从矢量索引中每张纸文档池中的统一随机抽样,而不是通过与模板段落相近的语义来选择 k k 体文字段落.
这就使正文文本访问固定下来,同时放大检索质量,从而将定向检索的贡献与正文文本访问本身的贡献隔离开来。

blocks.en:
Runs the same model and prompts, with the same per-paper chunk pool, but passes every body chunk of the paper in document order instead of k k of them, so the prompt holds the whole parsed body (the longest prompts have 22451 22451 and 22771 22771 tokens for the two generators, within their context windows).
It tests whether selecting passages is needed at all.
We ran this condition at T = 0 T{=}0 five times with gemini-2.5-flash and once with the fully local qwen2.5:32b-instruct , whose full-workflow outputs were identical across five repeats ( Section 10.3 ).
blocks.zh:
运行相同的模型和提示,每张纸块池相同,但按文件顺序通过每张纸块,而不是其中的kk,因此提示会将整张被解析的机体抱住(最长的提示会在其上下文窗口内为两台发电机提供22451 22451和22771 22771个令牌).
它检验是否需要选择段落。
我们以T = 0 T = = 0 5次使用相机-2.5-相机,一次使用完全本地的 qwen2.5:32b-instruct。 5次重复,其全工作流程输出相同(第10.3节)。

blocks.en: 11.3 Method requirements and performance trade-offs
blocks.zh: 11.3 联合国 方法要求和业绩权衡

blocks.en:
This comparison is not a leaderboard, but a map of what each approach requires in order to reach a given level of agreement.
The relevant trade-off is between annotation effort, text scope, and task flexibility: EpiLens uses analyst-specified categories that can be edited as text, requires no task-specific training labels, and grounds each decision in retrieved body-text evidence.
The baseline scores therefore measure not only modelling accuracy, but also what is lost or gained when one removes retrieval, restricts the text scope, or introduces labelled supervision.
blocks.zh:
这种比较并不是一个领导板,而是一张图,说明每种方法需要什么才能达到一定程度的协议.
相关的权衡是在说明努力、文本范围和任务灵活性之间: EpiLens使用分析师指定的类别,这些类别可以被编辑为文本,不需要特定任务的培训标签,并在取回的正文证据中为每项决定提供依据.
因此,基准分数不仅衡量建模准确性,而且还衡量在删除检索、限制文本范围或引入标注监督时损失或获得什么。

blocks.en: Table 3 collects the head-to-head results. The next two subsections compare methods first at title-and-abstract scope and then with access to body text.
blocks.zh: 表3收集了头对头结果。 后两分节首先在标题和抽象范围比较方法,然后与取用正文进行对比.

blocks.en:
To separate model effects from evidence access, we use metadata_llm as the pivot comparison.
This baseline keeps EpiLens’s generator and task instructions but restricts the evidence to paper metadata, i.e. the title and abstract.
It therefore answers two questions in sequence: first, at title-and-abstract scope, what does an instruction-following LLM buy relative to classical, neural, and zero-shot baselines? Second, what does targeted body-text retrieval add on top?
blocks.zh:
为了将模型效应与证据获取区分开来,我们使用元数据_llm作为中枢比较.
这个基线保留了 EpiLens 的生成器和任务指令,但将证据限制在纸质元数据,即标题和抽象.
因此,它依次回答两个问题:第一,在标题和抽象范围,一个跟随LLM的指令相对于古典,神经,和零镜头基线来说买什么? 第二,目标身体文本检索在顶部增加什么?

blocks.en: 11.3.1 Comparison at title-and-abstract scope
blocks.zh: 11.3.1 标题和摘要范围的比较

blocks.en:
At title-and-abstract scope, metadata_llm is the cleanest comparison because it uses the same instruction-following backend as EpiLens without targeted body-text retrieval.
Its performance ( 0.713 0.713 paper type, 0.826 0.826 geography, 0.816 0.816 data type, 0.241 0.241 data accessibility) shows that the benefit of the LLM at fixed evidence scope is task-dependent rather than uniform.
blocks.zh:
在标题和摘要范围,元数据_llm是最干净的比较,因为它使用与EpiLens相同的指令后端,没有目标正文文本检索.
其性能(0.713 0.713纸型,0.826 0.826地理学,0.816 0.816 数据型,0.241 0.241 数据可取性)表明,LLM在固定证据范围的优点取决于任务而非统一.

blocks.en:
Where the relevant signal is usually present in the abstract, the metadata-only LLM matches or exceeds the standard abstract-scoped baselines.
This is clearest for geography ( 0.826 0.826 vs. TF-IDF + SVM 0.592 0.592 , SetFit 0.599 0.599 , NLI 0.709 0.709 ), and roughly tied for paper type ( 0.713 0.713 vs. 0.713 0.713 for TF-IDF + SVM and 0.734 0.734 for SetFit).
But the labelled baselines are not dominated everywhere.
On data type , the bag-of-words and embedding classifiers perform better ( 0.854 0.854 and 0.864 0.864 vs. 0.816 0.816 ), consistent with a lexically regular task dominated by the near-universal Traditional label.
The clearest failure is data accessibility : metadata_llm reaches only 0.241 0.241 , far below the supervised abstract baselines ( 0.533 0.533 – 0.574 0.574 ), because the decisive access statement is rarely available in the abstract.
This marks the limit of metadata-only reasoning and identifies where retrieval should matter most.
blocks.zh:
当相关信号通常以抽象形式出现时,仅元数据LLM匹配或超过标准的抽象范围基线.
这在地理学上最为清晰(0.826 0.826 vs. TF-IDF + SVM 0.592 0.592, SetFit 0.599 0.599, NLI 0.709 0.709),并大致被绑为纸张类型(0.713 0.713 vs. 0.713 + TF-IDF + SVM 和 SetFit 0.734 0.734).
但是,标有标签的基线并非在任何地方都占主导地位。
在数据类型上,词包和嵌入式分类器表现较好(0.854 0.854和0.864 0.864对0.816 0.816),符合以近乎通用的传统标签为主的逻辑常态任务.
最明显的失败是数据的可获取性:元数据_llm只达到0.241 0.241,远远低于被监督的抽象基线(0.533 0.533 – 0.574 0.574),因为决定性的可获取性声明在抽象中很少获得.
这标志着只用元数据的推理的局限性,并指明了检索在哪些方面应最为重要。

blocks.en:
When compared against the strongest tuned abstract-scope supervised configuration rather than the standard representative rows ( Table 2 ), the metadata-only LLM’s advantage is narrower: it remains ahead only on geography ( 0.826 0.826 vs. 0.750 0.750 ), while tuned encoders overtake it elsewhere.
Thus, EpiLens’s consistent advantage is not simply instruction-following at fixed scope: it comes from adding body-text evidence.
blocks.zh:
与最强调制的抽象镜监督配置而非标准代表行(表2)相比,仅元数据的LLM的优势更窄:它仅在地理学上处于领先地位(0.826 0.826 vs. 0.750 0.750),而调制编码器则在其他地方超越了它.
因此,EpiLens的一贯优势不仅仅是在固定范围内遵循指示:它来自增加正文证据。

blocks.en:
The weakest baseline scores should be read as diagnostics of default method–task mismatch, not as ceilings on the corresponding model families.
Zero-shot NLI on data type is the clearest case ( J = 0.018 J{=}0.018 ): it almost never predicts the dominant Traditional class.
This appears to reflect a lexical-anchoring asymmetry rather than a residual-category effect: in our protocol Traditional is defined positively (standard surveillance case counts, hospital admissions, PCR/antigen-confirmed test line lists), but it is a broad, heterogeneous category that papers signal only implicitly, since a paper reporting national surveillance counts rarely states in so many words that it uses “traditional” data.
The non-traditional categories, by contrast, each name a specific kind of source (mobility, health, sentiment, economic) that papers typically do state explicitly, giving an entailment hypothesis built from the label name a much stronger lexical anchor to key on than Traditional offers.
blocks.zh:
应将最弱的基准分数理解为默认方法的诊断 — — 任务不匹配,而不是相应的模范家庭的上限。
数据类型的零射出NLI是最清楚的案例(J = 0.018 J = 0.018):它几乎从未预测过占主导地位的传统阶层.
这似乎反映了一种语法上的不对称,而不是残余类别的影响:在我们的协议中,传统的定义是积极的(标准监视案例数、住院人数、PCR/抗原确认的测试线清单),但是,文件只暗含着一种广泛的、不同的类别,因为报告国家监测的论文很少用如此多的字眼说明它使用“传统”数据。
相比之下,非传统类别中的每一名称都是论文中通常明确表述的具体来源(流动、健康、情绪、经济),使从标签名称中得出的必然假设比传统报价更强。

blocks.en:
Prototype similarity shows a different failure mode: its uncalibrated version is a minimal annotation-free semantic-matching baseline, while threshold calibration uses labels to recover part of the gap.
For example, calibration improves SPECTER on data type from 0.52 0.52 to 0.67 0.67 , and TF-IDF on data accessibility from 0.22 0.22 to 0.25 0.25 ( Table 3 ).
We therefore treat the calibrated prototype as a minimal supervised method and the uncalibrated prototype as a zero-shot diagnostic.
blocks.zh:
原型相似性显示出不同的故障模式:其未校正版本是一个最小的无注释语义匹配基线,而阈值校正则使用标签来取回部分缺口.
例如,校正改进了SPECTER的数据类型从0.52 0.52到0.67 0.67,TF-IDF的数据可访问性从0.22 0.22到0.250.25(表3).
因此,我们把校正原型当作一种最低限度的有监督的方法,把未校正原型当作是零发诊断.

blocks.en: 11.3.2 Comparison with body-text access
blocks.zh: 11.3.2 与正文链接的比较

blocks.en:
Moving from metadata_llm to full EpiLens holds the generator and task instructions fixed while replacing metadata-only evidence with targeted body-text retrieval.
The resulting difference estimates the contribution of evidence access and evidence selection, and it tracks where the discriminative signal lies.
On geography , where the abstract already carries much of the signal, retrieval adds little: EpiLens ( 0.875 0.875 ) is only slightly ahead of the metadata-only LLM ( 0.826 0.826 ), and the paired difference does not meet the adjusted threshold ( Section 11.4 ).
This is the only comparison in which EpiLens does not clearly lead.
On the other three axes, EpiLens is ahead of every tested abstract-scoped baseline under the paired tests reported in Table 1 .
The margin is largest where decisive evidence is distributed through the body or concentrated in a local statement: paper type improves from 0.713 0.713 to 0.877 0.877 , and data accessibility from 0.241 0.241 to 0.670 0.670 .
On data type , the margin is narrower ( 0.916 0.916 vs. TF-IDF + SVM 0.854 0.854 , Holm-adjusted p = 0.0008 p{=}0.0008 ), and full-document TF-IDF recovers much of the difference ( 0.881 0.881 , Table 2 ), suggesting that this axis is driven more by broad lexical evidence than by label-targeted retrieval.
blocks.zh:
从元数据_llm 移动到全 EpiLens 持有生成器并固定任务指令,同时以定向的正文文本检索来取代只使用元数据的证据.
由此产生的差异估计了证据获取和证据选择的贡献,并跟踪了歧视信号所在.
在地理学上,抽象已经携带了大部分信号,检索很少增加: EpiLens(0.875 0.875)仅略高于仅元数据的LLM(0.826 0.826),而配对的相差达不到调整后的阈值(第11.4节).
这是EpiLens没有明显领先的唯一比较.
在其他三个轴上,EpiLens在表1所报的对接试验下,领先于每一个被测试的抽象范围基线.
当决定性证据通过正体分配或集中到本地报表中时,差值最大:纸张类型从0.713 0.713提高到0.877 0.877;数据可获取性从0.241 0.241提高到0.670 0.670.
关于数据类型,比值更窄(0.916 0.916 vs. TF-IDF + SVM 0.854 0.854,霍尔姆调整后p = 0.0008 p {=}0.0008),完整文档的TF-IDF 恢复了大部分相差(0.881 0.881,表2),说明这个轴由广义的词典证据所驱动,而不是由标签目标检索所驱动.

blocks.en:
This body-text access is not an information advantage withheld from the baselines.
Title and abstract are the natural scope for short-window encoders and off-the-shelf zero-shot classifiers, but we also evaluate supervised methods with body-text access in the configuration grid: full-document vectorisation for TF-IDF, chunk-and-pool variants for short-window encoders, and ModernBERT ’s 8192 8192 -token long-context window for the dense long-context setting ( Table 2 ).
The distinction is therefore not whether baselines are allowed to read the body, but how it is used: the language model applies the coding protocol to body-text passages, and selecting those passages by the labels adds most for data accessibility.
The component ablation ( Section 4.2.2 ) decomposes this retrieval contribution directly, while the supervised grid and saturation analysis ( Section 11.5 ) make an under-powered baseline or small-label artefact unlikely as the main explanation.
blocks.zh:
这种正文访问并非从基线中扣取的信息优势。
标题和抽象是短窗编码器和现成零发分级器的自然范围,但我们也评价在配置网格中带正文访问的受监督方法:TF-IDF的全文件矢量化,短窗编码器的块和集合变体;和ModernBERT的8192 8192-token长文本窗口用于密集长文本设置(表2).
因此区别不在于是否允许基线读取正文,而在于如何使用:语言模型将编码协议应用于正文-正文段落,用标签来选择这些段落对数据的可访问性增加最多.
元件膨胀(第4.2.2节)直接分解了这种取回贡献,而受监督的网格和饱和度分析(第11.5节)则使得动力不足的基线或小标签的活性能不可能作为主要解释.

blocks.en: 11.4 Statistical methodology
blocks.zh: 11.4 统计方法

blocks.en:
The baseline comparison in Section 4.2.3 uses the mean per-paper Jaccard score defined in Section 4.2 on the same 214 214 manually labelled papers. We use paired resampling to check how sensitive the observed baseline differences and the ablation differences in Section 4.2.2 are to the papers evaluated. For EpiLens with gemini-2.5-flash , each paper’s score is averaged over five runs.
The supervised baselines use out-of-fold predictions: within each configuration, each paper is predicted by a model fitted without that paper.
blocks.zh:
第4.2.3节的基线比较采用第4.2节界定的同214 214份手工标注的纸上每张纸的平均分数。 我们利用对接的再抽样检查第4.2.2节中观察到的基线差异和衰减差异对所评估的文件的敏感性。 EpiLens的分数平均为5分。
所监督的基线使用外向预测:在每一种配置中,每张纸都用没有纸张的模型来预测。

blocks.en:
For each comparison, we resample the per-paper Jaccard differences with replacement ( B = 10 000 B{=}10\,000 ) and calculate a bias-corrected and accelerated (BCa) interval for their mean.
This keeps both methods’ scores paired on each paper; BCa adjusts the interval for bias and skewness ( Efron, 1987 ) .
We report pointwise 95 % 95\% intervals; each two-sided p-value is the smallest significance level at which the corresponding BCa interval excludes zero.
We apply Holm–Bonferroni correction within each task, separately for the baseline comparisons and each generator’s ablation comparisons.
Holm’s step-down adjustment limits the chance of at least one false rejection within each comparison family ( Holm, 1979 ) . Tables 1 and 3 give the same BCa interval for one configuration’s mean J J , resampling papers in the same way.
This resampling holds the manual labels, model predictions, and selected configurations fixed. It does not reproduce the review-stratified sampling design or model fitting, so the intervals describe sensitivity to these papers rather than uncertainty about performance across corpora.
blocks.zh:
对于每次比较,我们用置换(B=一万B=一万B=一万B=一万)来重现每张纸的Jaccard差数,并按其平均值计算出一个偏差校正和加速(BCa)间隔.
这使得两种方法的分数在每张纸上都成对;BCa调整了偏差和扭曲的间隔(Efron,1987年)。
我们报告指向95%的95-%的间隔;每个双侧的p-值是相应的BCa间隔排除0的最小意义级.
我们在每个任务中分别使用Holm-Bonferroni校正来进行基线比较和每个生成器的衰减比较。
Holm的逐步下调限制了每个比较家庭至少一次错误拒绝的机会(Holm,1979年). 表1和表3对一个配置的中间JJ给出了相同的BCa间隔,以同样的方式对论文进行再版.
此复刻将手动标签,模型预测和所选配置固定. 它不复制经过审查的抽样设计或模型的相适应性,因此间隔时间描述的是这些文件的敏感性,而不是整个公司业绩的不确定性。

blocks.en: In Table 1 , all twelve gaps to the three named supervised baselines meet the adjusted threshold. This supports the observed lead over those baselines under resampling of the labelled papers. The smaller geography gap against the abstract-only metadata_llm ( Δ ​ J = + 0.049 \Delta J{=}{+}0.049 ) does not meet the threshold, leaving the extra gain from the full workflow over metadata alone uncertain on that axis.
blocks.zh: 在表1中,所命名的3个监督基线的所有12个缺口都达到了调整后的阈值。 这有助于在重新标出标有标签的文件后在这些基线上发现的铅。 相对于抽象的元数据_llm(QQ J = + 0.049),地理差距较小 \Delta J{=}{+}0.049)没有达到阈值,使得整个工作流程相对于元数据的额外收益仅在该轴上不确定.

blocks.en: 11.5 Comprehensive supervised configuration grid and saturation
blocks.zh: 11.5 综合监督配置网格和饱和度

blocks.en:
To position EpiLens against a wider range of supervised approaches than the named representatives of Section 11.3 , Table 2 crosses three choices. The representations are sparse TF-IDF, frozen all-mpnet-base-v2 ( Song et al., 2020 ; Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) , frozen SPECTER ( Cohan et al., 2020 ) , and the frozen 8192-token long-context ModernBERT-base . Text scope is either title and abstract or full body, ingested by chunk-and-pool for the short-window encoders and within ModernBERT ’s 8192 8192 -token window, with overflow mean-pooled across windows. The classifier heads are linear SVM, logistic regression, gradient-boosted trees, and MLP. Each combination follows the same stratified 5-fold protocol over the same N = 214 N{=}214 papers, with leave-one-out additionally reported for the linear heads.
The MPNet embedding uses the sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 checkpoint ( Sentence Transformers, 2026 ) .
Every cell is head-only supervision ( Section 11.2.3 ): the representation is fixed (unsupervised TF-IDF or a frozen encoder) and only the head is trained, so the grid isolates representation family, text scope, and head choice without the confound of end-to-end fine-tuning.
The heads use fixed settings, not tuned in an inner cross-validation loop, and all configurations share one fold partition.
The Best supervised row offsets this in the baselines’ favour: it picks the best configuration for each axis on the evaluation papers themselves, which overstates what a configuration chosen in advance would reach.
Full-body access and dense encoders both raise the best score reached in the grid, and non-linear heads edge the linear ones on dense representations, but no cell reaches EpiLens on any axis ( Table 2 ). The long-context ModernBERT , whose 8192 8192 -token window holds the full body of 182 182 of the 214 214 papers in a single window (the 32 32 longer papers, up to ∼ 16 {\sim}16 k tokens, are mean-pooled across a few windows, as the short-window encoders always are), lands in the same band, suggesting that short input windows alone do not explain the gap to EpiLens.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 11.6 Corpus-structure audit

blocks.en:
The topic models of Section 11.1 are run not as classifiers but as a corpus-structure audit : a check of how separable each axis’s categories are by vocabulary alone, which bounds how much of the task a purely lexical, retrieval-free method could solve in principle. Table 3 reports the best J J each model reaches across the K K sweep under an oracle cluster-to-label alignment, an upper bound on that structural signal.
Even so, topic models only partly recover the lexically regular axes ( paper type , data type ) and sit near the majority floor on data accessibility : the categories that demand reading and reasoning are exactly the ones vocabulary structure cannot separate, which is where retrieval-grounded reading is decisive.

blocks.en: 12 Linking estimates to corpus papers
blocks.zh: 12 将估计数与案卷联系起来

blocks.en:
As described in Section 4.1 , the corpus was assembled from sources named in the seed study’s early extraction sheets ( Ward et al., 2025 ) .
Here we describe how the estimates in those sheets were linked to corpus papers for the comparisons in Section 4.4 , and check how review coverage and classification choices affect the main contrasts.
blocks.zh:
如第4.1节所说明的,该生物体是从种子研究早期采取表(Ward等,2025年)所标明的来源组装而成。
在此,我们说明这些表格中的估计数如何与第4.4节中比较的委托书联系起来,并检查审查范围和分类选择如何影响主要对比。

blocks.en: 12.1 Scope and inputs
blocks.zh: 12.1 范围和投入

blocks.en:
We use the data extraction sheets shared by the authors of the seed study.
The sheets are not redistributed.
They contain 346 346 estimate rows and, after identifiers are resolved, 138 138 distinct published sources.
The sheets are a working version and do not exactly match either the first preprint or the published article.
The first preprint reports 342 342 estimates ( Ward et al., 2025 ) .
Five sources behind eight sheet rows do not appear in its references.
The published article ( Ward et al., 2026 ) reports a revised set of 302 302 estimates from 154 154 articles.
All counts below refer to the early sheets.
blocks.zh:
我们使用种子研究作者共享的数据提取表.
床单没有重新分配。
它们包含346,346个估计数行,在识别资料解决后,有138,138个不同的公开来源。
这些工作表是工作版,既不完全符合第一份预印本,也不完全符合已发表的文章.
第一份预印报告为342 342项估计数(Ward等人,2025年)。
8行工作表后面的5个来源不在其参考文献中出现.
所发表的文章(Ward等,2026年)从154篇154篇的文章中报告了302,302篇的修订估计.
下面的所有统计都指早期的床单.

blocks.en:
We group the parameters into seven categories: reproduction number (basic, effective, or controlled), serial interval, incubation period, latent period, infectious period (including effective infectious periods), dispersion parameter k k , and fatality risk (case or infection).
These groups combine related quantities for describing their cited papers.
blocks.zh:
我们把这些参数分为七类:复制号(基本、有效或受控制)、序列间隔、孵化期、潜伏期、传染期(包括有效传染期)、分散参数kk和死亡风险(病例或感染)。
这些小组将相关数量结合起来,说明所引用的论文。

blocks.en:
We call a review cited by an estimate a source review .
An expanded source review is one whose included studies are linked to corpus records, whether through corpus construction or a published study list.
blocks.zh:
我们把估计引用的审查称为来源审查。
一项扩大的资料来源审查是,其包含的研究与人身记录相联系,无论是通过人身构造还是公布的研究清单。

blocks.en: 12.2 Matching cited sources
blocks.zh: 12.2 匹配引用来源

blocks.en:
Nineteen sheet rows have no published source to link, mostly because they relate to the seed study’s own incubation-period calculations.
We link the other 327 327 to their cited sources, as illustrated in Figure 1 .
For a directly cited study or other document, we analyse that source itself.
A source review links to its included studies present in the corpus.
blocks.zh:
十九行表没有公布的可链接的来源,主要是因为它们与种子研究本身的孵化期计算有关.
如图1所示,我们把其他327 327与其引用的来源联系起来。
对于直接引用的研究或其他文件,我们分析来源本身。
来源审查与本文书所载研究报告的联系。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Linking parameter estimates to corpus papers. The 327 327 sheet rows citing a published source divide into reviews and single studies or other documents. A review principally links to its retrieved included studies in the corpus, while a directly cited document is itself analysed. The review and document counts are distinct sources after identifiers are resolved.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 将参数估计数与案卷联系起来。 327行327页取出已公布的资料来源,分为评论和单一研究或其他文件。 一项审查主要与其检索的链接包括了本文书中的研究报告,同时对直接引用的文件本身进行了分析。 在识别资料解决后,审查和文件清点是不同的来源。

blocks.en:
The corpus-building records group included studies under the source review’s first author and year.
We use these identifiers to connect a sheet citation to the appropriate group and check the DOI for reviews sharing an author and year.
We match individual documents chiefly by DOI, with author and year or verified manual matching where needed.
Where an identifier is malformed, takes a different form, or identifies another document, we apply a declared replacement checked against Crossref ( Hendricks et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh:
人身保护记录组包括了来源审查的第一位作者和年度的研究。
我们使用这些标识符将一个工作表引用符与适当的组连接起来,并检查DOI是否共享一个作者和一年的评论.
我们主要通过内政部匹配单个文件,必要时与作者和年份或经核实的手工匹配。
如果一个标识符不正确,形式不同,或识别出另一个文件,我们则对Crossref使用已宣布的替换(Hendricks等人,2020年)。

blocks.en: 12.3 Associated paper sets and labels
blocks.zh: 12.3 相关纸张和标签

blocks.en:
The corpus records links between its papers and the sources named in the sheets.
We use those links to define the paper set associated with each estimate row r r , denoted B r B_{r} .
For a directly cited study or other document, B r B_{r} contains that document.
For a source review, B r B_{r} contains its included studies that are present in the corpus ( Section 8 ).
These are studies the review identifies as evidence for its analysis, rather than every item in its bibliography.
The sheets cite the review for a particular estimate without naming the contributing studies.
For example, a review reporting both serial-interval and incubation-period estimates may use different subsets of its included studies for each.
Thus B r B_{r} reflects the review’s included evidence, which may be broader than the studies used for one value.
Then, a paper can be included in several reviews even if it was first retrieved for just one.
We retain every documented membership.
For each parameter, pathogen, or combination of the two, we take the union of the corresponding B r B_{r} sets.
Each paper contributes once to a group’s paper count and label shares, regardless of how many estimates link to it.
The same paper may appear in several groups, so their paper counts are not additive.
blocks.zh:
案卷记录了案卷与被单所列来源之间的联系。
我们用这些链接来定义与每个估算行r r相接的相接文件集,表示B r B_{r}.
对于直接引用的研究报告或其他文件,Br B_{r}载有该文件。
为了进行来源审查,Br B_{r} 包含了其包含在诉讼文书中的研究(第8节)。
这些研究是审查所确定的分析证据,而不是其书目中的每一项目。
这些表格引用了对某一具体估计数的审查,但没有列出所提供的研究报告。
例如,审评报告序列间和孵化期估计数可能使用其包含的研究的不同子集。
因此,Br B_{r}反映了审查中包含的证据,这些证据可能比一个价值的研究要广泛。
之后,一份论文即使被首次检索到只有一份,也可以包括在多份评论中.
我们保留每个有文件记录的成员。
对于每个参数,病原体, 或两者的组合, 我们取对应的 B r B_{r} 集的结合 。
每篇论文都会贡献一次给一个团体的纸分和标签,
同一纸可能出现在多组中,因此其纸数不是添加剂.

blocks.en:
Table 1 tabulates model-based and simulated-data shares for the paper sets plotted in Figures 5 and 6 .
It also lists the influenza A subtypes pooled in the pathogen figure.
These percentages use the frozen gemini-2.5-flash labels at T = 0 T{=}0 over all associated corpus papers, so they are model outputs without sampling intervals.
The figures do not separate pathogens within each parameter. Table 2 provides that breakdown for the comparisons discussed in Section 4.4 .

表1列出了图5和图6中绘图的纸张集的模型和模拟数据份额。
它还列出了病原体图中集合的甲型流感亚型.
这些百分比在所有相关物证中使用T=0的被冻结的基因2.5-闪光标签,因此它们是没有取样间隔的模型输出.
这些数字并不将病原体在每一参数内分开。 表2列出了第4.4节所讨论比较的细目。

blocks.en: 12.4 Manual-label check
blocks.zh: 12.4 人工标签检查

blocks.en:
The shares reported for all associated papers in Section 4.4 depend on model-assigned labels.
We therefore check whether the contrast also appears under manual labels among the associated papers in the 214 214 -paper evaluation sample.
The manual labels show the same ordering, with a 38 38 -percentage-point difference in model-based shares.
We examine how this difference varies across the cited sources represented in that sample.
blocks.zh:
第4.4节所述所有相关文件的股份取决于模式指定标签。
因此,我们检查在214至214纸面评价样本的相关文件中是否也以人工标签出现对比。
手动标签显示的顺序相同,在以模型为基础的股票中,有38个38-百分点的差异.
我们研究了这一差异在样本中所提到的来源之间有何不同。

blocks.en:
The paired bootstrap in Section 11.4 resamples individual papers to assess differences in classifier accuracy.
Here, several labelled papers can come from one cited review, so we resample source reviews and directly cited documents as groups.
This asks whether the manual-label contrast depends heavily on a few cited sources.
blocks.zh:
第11.4节中的配对靴重新标出单个文件,以评估分类器准确性的差异。
在此,一些贴有标签的论文可以来自一个被引用的回顾,因此我们重新取用源评论,并直接以分组方式引用文件.
这询问手册-标签对比是否严重依赖于几个引用的来源.

blocks.en:
The resampling pool contains 45 45 sources represented by at least one labelled paper behind either parameter.
In each of 4000 4000 draws, we select 45 45 sources with replacement, keep each selected source’s labelled papers together, and recalculate the difference between the two manual-label shares.
A source shared by both parameters contributes to both shares in the same draw.
Within each parameter set, a paper linked to m m sources receives weight 1 / m 1/m through each source, so that it counts once in the observed share.
The central 95 % 95\% of resampled differences is 19 19 – 57 57 percentage points, preserving the direction under this source resampling.
This check concerns the manually labelled subset: the papers labelled within each review stay fixed, and the interval does not estimate what manual labels would show across the full associated paper sets.

blocks.en: 12.5 Sensitivity of the paper profiles
blocks.zh: 12.5 论文简介的敏感性

blocks.en: We now check whether the model-assigned reproduction-number–fatality-risk contrast across all associated papers changes with review coverage, model choice, or the removal of individual source reviews.
blocks.zh: 现在,我们检查所有相关文件的模型分配复制号-脂肪-风险对比是否随着审查范围、模型选择或个别来源审查的删除而发生变化。

blocks.en:
Incomplete matching of a review’s included studies could change the paper profiles.
We linked corpus papers to 62 62 cited reviews, of which 60 60 report how many studies they included. The other two are an analytic perspective and a narrative review without a defined set of included studies.
Counting a paper once for each review that includes it, corpus records match 2706 2706 of 4467 4467 reported inclusions ( 61 % 61\% ).
These are shares of reported review inclusions, not shares of the corpus.
Matching varies from 14 14 to 100 % 100\% across reviews and is 47 % 47\% for those associated with reproduction numbers, against 56 % 56\% for fatality risks.
blocks.zh:
列入审查的研究报告不完全匹配可能会改变论文简介。
我们把专题文件与62项评论联系起来,其中60项报告包括了多少项研究。 另外两个是分析视角和叙述性回顾,没有一套明确的包含的研究。
在每一次审查中都计算出一份论文,案卷记录与4467 4467中报告的2706 2706件(61% 61%)相符。
这些是所报审查内容中的份额,而不是文书中的份额。
在所有审查中,匹配率从14.14%到100%(100%)不等,而与繁殖数量有关的匹配率为47%(47%),而致命风险为56%(56%)。

blocks.en:
Removing reviews below the median matching rate, while retaining directly cited documents and reviews without reported totals, changes the model-based difference from 32 32 to 39 39 percentage points.
Hence, the direction persists.
blocks.zh:
取消低于中位比比率的审查,同时保留直接引用的文件和审查而不报告总数,将基于模型的差额从32个百分点改为39个百分点。
因此,方向仍然存在。

blocks.en:
Under the fully local qwen2.5:32b-instruct configuration, the model-based shares are 53 % 53\% for reproduction numbers and 15 % 15\% for fatality risks, compared with 54 % 54\% and 22 % 22\% under Flash.
The simulated-data difference is smaller with the local configuration ( 31 % 31\% versus 8 % 8\% , compared with 48 % 48\% versus 13 % 13\% under Flash).
blocks.zh:
在完全本地化的qwen2.5:32b-struct配置下,基于模型的股份为:复制号码为53%-%,死亡风险为15%-%,而Flash下为54%-54%-%,22-%-%。
本地配置的模拟数据差异较小(31 % 31 % 相对于8% 8 % , 而Flash下为48% 48 % 相对于13% 13 % )。

blocks.en:
With the Flash labels, omitting each of the 42 42 source reviews in turn leaves the model-based difference at 28 28 – 36 36 percentage points.
The model-based ordering therefore holds under both configurations and after the removal of any one review.
blocks.zh:
随着"闪电"的标签,将42个42个源评论中的每一个都省略了,从而使得基于模型的相差为28–36个百分点.
因此,基于模型的订单在两种配置下以及在取消任何一项审查后都保持不变。

blocks.en:
In Section 4.4 , 55 % 55\% of the 334 334 SARS-CoV-2 papers associated with incubation-period estimates are labelled model-based, compared with 6 % 6\% of the 115 115 mpox papers.
We check whether this difference depends on one source review or on papers also linked to other parameters.
The manual comparison covers only 31 31 and 11 11 papers, so these checks use the full model-assigned sets.
blocks.zh:
在第4.4节中,与孵化期估计有关的334份SARS-CoV-2文件中,55%的55%的论文以模型为基础,而115份115份催化文件中有6%的论文以模型为基础。
我们检查这种差别是取决于一个来源审查,还是取决于与其他参数也相联的文件。
人工比较只涵盖31个31个和11个11个论文,因此这些检查使用完整的模型指定集.

blocks.en:
The model-based share is at least 24 % 24\% in each of seven SARS-CoV-2 source reviews and at most 11 % 11\% in each of four mpox source reviews.
The ordering therefore appears across the cited reviews, rather than arising only when their papers are pooled.
Excluding papers also linked to reproduction-number or fatality-risk estimates for the same pathogen leaves shares of 54 % 54\% of 201 201 SARS-CoV-2 papers and 6 % 6\% of 70 70 mpox papers.
These shares are close to those in the full associated sets ( 55 % 55\% and 6 % 6\% ), so papers shared with those other parameter sets do not account for the difference.
blocks.zh:
基于模型的占比在7个SARS-CoV-2源审评中,每个至少占24%-24-%,在4个mpox源审评中,每个最多占11%-11-%.
因此,命令出现在上述审查中,而不是只在文件汇集时才发出。
不包括与同一病原体的生殖数量或死亡风险估计有关的论文,在201份SARS-CoV-2论文中,54%的叶子份额为54%;70份多功能论文中,6%的叶子份额为6%。
这些股份接近于全部关联集的股份(55% 55 % 和6% 6 % ),因此与其他参数集共享的论文不计入差额.
